notion-airtable.tagline: Sync databases between Notion and Airtable and migrate data bidirectionally
notion-airtable.metaTitle: Notion + Airtable Automation - Sync and Migrate Data
notion-airtable.metaDescription: Connect Notion and Airtable with GAIA. Sync databases between Notion and Airtable, migrate data without manual exports, and keep both platforms updated as your data workflow evolves.
notion-airtable.intro:
Notion and Airtable are both powerful database tools, and many teams use both — Notion for documentation-rich, narrative-style databases and Airtable for structured, spreadsheet-like data that requires complex filtering, formulas, and API access. But when the same records need to exist in both systems, teams face a painful choice: maintain two separate databases manually, or accept that one will always be out of date.

GAIA eliminates this dilemma by keeping Notion databases and Airtable bases synchronized automatically. Records created in Airtable appear in Notion. Updates made to Notion properties propagate to Airtable fields. Teams can use whichever interface suits their workflow — Airtable's grid for data analysis, Notion's page view for narrative context — and always see the same underlying data. Data migration from Notion to Airtable (or vice versa) can be initiated with a single GAIA command rather than a manual export-import cycle.

This integration is valuable for operations teams that need Airtable's relational database power alongside Notion's wiki capabilities, for content teams that manage editorial calendars in both tools, and for any organization transitioning between the two platforms and needing a smooth, automated migration path.

useCases.title: Bidirectional database sync between Notion and Airtable
useCases.description: GAIA maintains a live, bidirectional sync between a Notion database and an Airtable base. New records, updated fields, and deleted entries in either platform are propagated to the other within minutes, keeping both databases consistently current.

useCases.title: Migrate data from Notion to Airtable on demand
useCases.description: When your team decides to move a Notion database to Airtable, GAIA handles the migration automatically — mapping Notion properties to Airtable field types, preserving relations where possible, and validating the migrated records to ensure data integrity.

useCases.title: Use Airtable for data analysis, Notion for narrative context
useCases.description: GAIA syncs the structured data fields bidirectionally while letting each tool maintain its strengths. Airtable handles formulas, lookups, and API integrations for data analysis; Notion stores the rich page content, comments, and documentation context that Airtable cannot represent.

useCases.title: Sync editorial calendars between content teams
useCases.description: Content teams using Airtable for structured editorial planning and Notion for article drafting can sync their calendars via GAIA so published status, publish dates, and author assignments are consistent in both tools without manual reconciliation.

useCases.title: Auto-create Airtable records from Notion form submissions
useCases.description: When a Notion form or database entry is created through a public Notion page, GAIA mirrors the submission to an Airtable base in real time, enabling Airtable's automation and integration capabilities to process the new record for CRM, reporting, or workflow triggers.

howItWorks.step: Connect Notion and Airtable to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Notion workspace and Airtable account in GAIA's integration settings. Select the Notion databases and Airtable bases that should be linked, and configure the sync direction — one-way push, one-way pull, or fully bidirectional.

howItWorks.step: Map fields between Notion and Airtable
howItWorks.description: GAIA guides you through matching Notion property types to Airtable field types. For properties with no direct equivalent, GAIA offers mapping options — for example, Notion rich text to an Airtable long text field or a Notion multi-select to an Airtable multiple select.

Once configured, GAIA monitors both platforms for changes and propagates updates between them automatically. You can run a full sync at any time via GAIA's conversational interface or let it run on the configured polling interval.

faqs.question: How does GAIA handle Notion relation properties during sync with Airtable?
faqs.answer: Notion relation properties are synced to Airtable linked record fields when the related Notion database is also synced to a corresponding Airtable table. If only one side of a relation is synced, GAIA converts the relation to a text field containing the related page title to preserve the reference.

faqs.question: Can GAIA handle Airtable formula fields during sync?
faqs.answer: Airtable formula fields are read-only computed values. GAIA can read and push formula field results to Notion as static values, but it does not replicate Airtable formulas in Notion — the formula logic itself stays in Airtable and only the computed result is synced.

faqs.question: What happens if the same record is edited in both platforms simultaneously?
faqs.answer: GAIA uses a last-write-wins conflict resolution strategy by default, where the most recently modified version of a record takes precedence. You can alternatively configure GAIA to flag conflicts for manual review rather than automatically resolving them, which is recommended for critical data.

notion-drive.tagline: Attach Drive files to Notion pages and organize Drive by your Notion structure
notion-drive.metaTitle: Notion + Google Drive Automation - Link Files and Docs
notion-drive.metaDescription: Connect Notion and Google Drive with GAIA. Automatically attach Drive files to Notion pages, mirror your Notion workspace structure in Drive folders, and keep file storage and documentation aligned.
notion-drive.intro:
Teams that use Notion as their primary wiki and Google Drive for file storage inevitably end up with two parallel organizational systems that do not know each other exists. A Notion project page has no link to the Drive folder with the relevant files. A Drive folder full of project assets has no connection to the Notion page where the project is documented. Finding everything related to a project means hunting across two separate systems with different organizational logic.

GAIA creates a unified organizational layer between Notion and Google Drive. When a Notion project page is created, GAIA can automatically create a corresponding Google Drive folder and link it in the Notion page. When a new file is added to a Drive folder, GAIA can attach it to the linked Notion page as an embedded file reference. The result is a project ecosystem where documentation and files are always connected — click from the Notion page to the Drive folder, or from Drive back to the Notion context.

This integration is essential for content teams managing production assets, design teams linking deliverables to project specs, and any knowledge-intensive organization that wants a single entry point to all project-related information regardless of whether it lives in a Google Doc or a Notion page.

useCases.title: Auto-create Drive folders when Notion projects are created
useCases.description: When a new entry is created in a Notion project database, GAIA automatically creates a corresponding Google Drive folder with the project name, adds the Drive folder link to the Notion page, and organizes it within the correct parent Drive directory.

useCases.title: Attach new Drive files to linked Notion pages
useCases.description: When a new file is added to a Google Drive folder linked to a Notion page, GAIA attaches the file to the Notion page as a link or embed so anyone viewing the Notion page can access the latest files without navigating to Drive separately.

useCases.title: Mirror Notion workspace structure in Google Drive
useCases.description: GAIA can generate a Google Drive folder hierarchy that mirrors your Notion workspace structure — creating team, project, and document-level folders that correspond to your Notion pages — so file storage and documentation share the same organizational logic.

useCases.title: Sync Google Doc titles with Notion page titles
useCases.description: When a Notion page title changes, GAIA updates the title of the linked Google Doc in Drive, and vice versa. This keeps cross-references accurate and ensures that searches in either platform surface the right document.

useCases.title: Archive Notion pages to Google Drive on deletion
useCases.description: When a Notion page is deleted or moved to an archive database, GAIA exports the page content as a Google Doc in a Drive archive folder, providing a non-Notion backup of important documentation that persists beyond the Notion workspace.

howItWorks.step: Connect Notion and Google Drive to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Notion workspace and Google Drive account in GAIA's integration settings. Select which Notion databases should have linked Drive folders and which Drive folders GAIA should monitor for new file attachments.

howItWorks.step: Set your folder and attachment preferences
howItWorks.description: Configure the Drive folder naming convention, the parent folder where new project folders should be created, which Notion property should store the Drive folder link, and whether file attachments should appear as links or embedded in the Notion page.

howItWorks.step: GAIA links your files and documentation automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Notion for new pages and updates and Drive for new files, creating folder structures and attachments automatically. Your team can navigate seamlessly between documentation and files without maintaining separate organizational systems.

faqs.question: Can GAIA work with Google Shared Drives for team file storage?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA supports Google Shared Drives (formerly Team Drives) in addition to personal Google Drive. When using Shared Drives, GAIA creates project folders within the configured Shared Drive and links them to Notion, ensuring all team members with Shared Drive access can also reach the linked files.

faqs.question: What file types can GAIA attach from Drive to Notion?
faqs.answer: GAIA can attach any file type stored in Google Drive to Notion, including Google Docs, Google Sheets, Slides, PDFs, images, videos, and other file formats. Files are linked by their Drive URL, so they open in the appropriate application when accessed from Notion.

faqs.question: If a file is moved in Drive, does GAIA update the link in Notion?
faqs.answer: Google Drive file links are stable and do not change when a file is moved between folders, so existing Notion attachments continue to work correctly after a Drive reorganization. Folder links may update if the folder is moved, and GAIA can detect these changes and update Notion folder references accordingly.

notion-zoom.tagline: Post Zoom meeting summaries to Notion pages automatically
notion-zoom.metaTitle: Notion + Zoom Automation - Meeting Notes to Notion
notion-zoom.metaDescription: Connect Notion and Zoom with GAIA. Automatically post Zoom meeting summaries and transcripts to Notion pages, capture action items, and build a searchable meeting archive in your Notion workspace.
keywords: save Zoom meeting notes to Notion
notion-zoom.intro:
Zoom meetings generate enormous amounts of valuable information — decisions, action items, project updates, and strategic discussions — but almost none of it gets documented in a systematic way. Meeting notes end up in someone's personal document, never linked to the Notion pages where the relevant projects are tracked. Transcripts pile up in Zoom's cloud storage, unsearchable and disconnected from the rest of the team's knowledge base. The same decisions get made in meetings repeatedly because no one can find the record of the previous discussion.

GAIA automatically bridges Zoom and Notion to capture every meeting's value into your knowledge base. When a Zoom meeting ends, GAIA generates a structured summary from the transcript — highlighting key decisions, action items, participants, and topics discussed — and posts it to the designated Notion page. Recurring meetings build a chronological archive of notes in Notion automatically. Action items extracted from meeting transcripts become Notion tasks linked to the right project pages.

This integration transforms how organizations use meeting time. Participants can focus on the conversation instead of frantic note-taking. Anyone who misses a meeting can read the Notion summary in minutes. Leaders can track decisions and commitments across all meetings from a central Notion database. The institutional knowledge generated in Zoom finally has a permanent, organized home.

useCases.title: Auto-generate meeting notes in Notion after every Zoom call
useCases.description: When a Zoom meeting ends, GAIA processes the meeting transcript and creates a structured Notion page with the meeting title, date, attendees, key discussion points, decisions made, and action items so every meeting is documented without anyone taking manual notes.

useCases.title: Extract and create Notion tasks from action items
useCases.description: GAIA parses Zoom transcripts for commitments and action items — 'John will send the report by Friday,' 'we need to update the pricing page' — and creates corresponding Notion tasks assigned to the right team members with appropriate due dates.

useCases.title: Build a searchable meeting archive in Notion
useCases.description: All Zoom meeting summaries are added to a centralized Notion meetings database organized by date, team, and project. The database becomes a searchable institutional archive so anyone can find what was discussed and decided in any meeting, no matter how long ago.

useCases.title: Link meeting notes to project pages automatically
useCases.description: GAIA uses meeting titles, invitees, and transcript content to identify the relevant Notion project page and links the meeting notes there, so every project page in Notion has a complete history of all meetings related to that project.

useCases.title: Send meeting summary digests to stakeholders
useCases.description: After Notion captures the meeting notes, GAIA can send a summary to meeting participants and any other stakeholders who were not present, including action item owners, so everyone is aligned on outcomes without reading the full transcript.

howItWorks.step: Connect Notion and Zoom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Notion workspace and Zoom account in GAIA's integration settings. Enable Zoom cloud recording and transcription so GAIA can access meeting transcripts, and select the Notion database where meeting notes should be saved.

Tell GAIA how to structure meeting notes in Notion — which properties to populate, how to format summaries, how to identify action items, and how to match meetings to the right Notion project pages. You can configure different templates for different meeting types.

howItWorks.step: GAIA documents every meeting in Notion automatically
howItWorks.description: After every Zoom meeting, GAIA processes the transcript, generates a structured summary, creates the Notion page, and links it to the relevant project. Your knowledge base grows with every meeting your team holds, with zero manual documentation effort.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require Zoom cloud recording to be enabled?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA accesses meeting transcripts through Zoom's cloud recording feature, which is available on Zoom Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans. If cloud recording is not enabled for a meeting, GAIA can still create a meeting notes template in Notion pre-populated with attendee and meeting metadata for manual completion.

faqs.question: Can GAIA generate notes for meetings I did not host?
faqs.answer: GAIA can generate notes for any Zoom meeting where the connected Zoom account has access to the cloud recording. For meetings hosted by others in your organization, the meeting host must share cloud recording access or the organization must use a Zoom account with centralized recording management.

faqs.question: How accurate are the AI-generated meeting summaries?
faqs.answer: GAIA's meeting summaries are generated from Zoom's transcript using an AI model trained for structured summarization. Accuracy depends on transcript quality, which improves with clear audio and speakers identifying themselves. You can always edit the generated Notion page, and GAIA learns your formatting preferences over time.

notion-hubspot.tagline: Sync HubSpot CRM data to Notion and document customer context alongside deals
notion-hubspot.metaTitle: Notion + HubSpot Automation - CRM Data in Your Notion Wiki
notion-hubspot.metaDescription: Connect Notion and HubSpot with GAIA. Sync CRM contacts, deals, and company data to Notion databases, document customer context alongside HubSpot records, and keep sales and operations aligned.
notion-hubspot.intro:
Sales teams live in HubSpot while the broader organization — product, customer success, engineering — works in Notion. The result is that customer context stays locked inside HubSpot, accessible only to sales team members. Important customer feedback, special agreements, implementation notes, and relationship history never make it into the Notion workspace where product decisions are made and customer success plans are documented. When a deal closes, the context that sales built up over months of relationship development rarely transfers to the team that will actually deliver the product.

GAIA connects HubSpot and Notion to make customer intelligence accessible across the organization. HubSpot contacts, companies, and deals can be synced to Notion databases where product, engineering, and success teams can add context, documentation, and notes alongside the CRM data. When a deal moves to a new stage in HubSpot, the linked Notion page updates automatically. When a customer success manager adds implementation notes to Notion, GAIA can push key data points back to the HubSpot record.

This integration is transformative for customer-centric organizations that want to break down the silos between sales, product, and success. It is especially valuable during the critical handoff from sales to implementation, where all the context a sales rep built needs to flow immediately to the people responsible for delivering on the promise.

useCases.title: Sync HubSpot deals to a Notion pipeline database
useCases.description: GAIA syncs HubSpot deals to a Notion database, keeping deal stage, value, close date, and owner properties current in both systems. Sales leaders can view deal status in Notion alongside product plans and customer context without toggling to HubSpot.

useCases.title: Auto-create Notion pages for new HubSpot contacts
useCases.description: When a new contact is created in HubSpot, GAIA creates a corresponding Notion page pre-populated with the contact's name, company, email, and deal history. The page serves as a customer context hub where any team member can add notes, meeting summaries, and project links.

useCases.title: Document customer implementation plans linked to HubSpot deals
useCases.description: Customer success teams can create detailed implementation plans in Notion linked to the corresponding HubSpot deal. GAIA keeps the HubSpot deal stage and the Notion project status synchronized, giving leadership a unified view of both sales and delivery progress.

useCases.title: Push Notion customer notes back to HubSpot
useCases.description: When a customer success manager or account manager adds a significant note or meeting summary to a Notion customer page, GAIA can push a summarized version to the corresponding HubSpot contact timeline so sales reps always have access to post-sales customer interactions.

useCases.title: Alert the team in Notion when HubSpot deals close
useCases.description: When a HubSpot deal moves to 'Closed Won,' GAIA creates a handoff task in a Notion operations database, includes the deal value, customer name, and key requirements from the HubSpot record, and notifies the implementation team so onboarding begins immediately after close.

howItWorks.step: Connect Notion and HubSpot to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Notion workspace and HubSpot portal through GAIA's integration settings. Select which HubSpot objects — contacts, companies, deals, or tickets — should sync to Notion, and which Notion databases should receive them.

howItWorks.step: Configure your data mapping and sync rules
howItWorks.description: Map HubSpot properties to Notion database properties, define which HubSpot pipeline stages trigger Notion updates, set the direction of sync for each property, and configure which team members should be notified of key events like deal closes.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps CRM and documentation in sync automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors HubSpot for CRM updates and Notion for documentation changes, propagating relevant data between the two platforms automatically. Your entire organization gets visibility into customer relationships without needing HubSpot access.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync HubSpot custom properties to Notion?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA reads all custom properties defined in your HubSpot portal and lets you map them to corresponding Notion database properties. This includes custom contact properties, deal properties, and company properties created for your specific business process.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support HubSpot's association between contacts, companies, and deals?
faqs.answer: GAIA syncs the primary association data between HubSpot objects to Notion relation properties where the linked Notion databases are also synced. For example, a Notion contact page can have a relation to the linked company page and deal page if all three HubSpot object types are configured for sync.

faqs.question: Is bidirectional sync safe — could Notion changes overwrite important HubSpot data?
faqs.answer: GAIA's bidirectional sync is carefully managed. By default, GAIA only writes to HubSpot fields that you explicitly designate as writable, and all Notion-to-HubSpot sync is logged. We recommend starting with one-way HubSpot-to-Notion sync and enabling bidirectional sync selectively after validating the field mappings.

github-jira.tagline: Keep GitHub PRs and Jira tickets in sync so your sprint board always reflects the true state of your code
github-jira.metaTitle: GitHub + Jira 연동: 코드와 스프린트 보드 동기화
github-jira.metaDescription: PR 이벤트에 맞춰 Jira 티켓을 옮기고, 새 스프린트 티켓으로 GitHub 이슈를 만듭니다. GAIA가 보드를 정확하게 유지합니다. 설정 단계를 확인하세요.
github-jira.intro:
Most engineering teams use both GitHub for code and Jira for project tracking, but keeping them synchronized is a constant manual chore. A developer merges a PR and forgets to move the Jira ticket to Done. A Jira issue gets closed by a product manager before the code is even reviewed. The sprint board drifts out of sync with the actual state of the codebase, and velocity reports become unreliable.

GAIA automates the handoff between GitHub and Jira so the two systems stay consistent without anyone having to remember to update both. When a PR is opened, GAIA transitions the linked Jira ticket to In Review. When the PR is merged, the ticket moves to Done automatically. When a Jira issue is created and added to a sprint, GAIA can open a corresponding GitHub issue or branch to match.

For engineering managers, this means sprint boards that accurately reflect code reality. For developers, it means one less context switch—write the code, merge the PR, and trust that the project tracker will catch up on its own.

useCases.title: Auto-transition Jira tickets on PR events
useCases.description: When a pull request is opened, GAIA moves the linked Jira issue to In Review. When the PR is merged, the ticket transitions to Done. When a PR is closed without merging, GAIA moves the ticket back to In Progress.

useCases.title: Create GitHub issues from new Jira sprint tickets
useCases.description: When a new Jira issue is added to a sprint, GAIA creates a linked GitHub issue in the appropriate repository so developers can track code-level work directly from GitHub without leaving their workflow.

useCases.title: Post PR review status to Jira ticket comments
useCases.description: GAIA posts a comment on the Jira ticket whenever the linked PR receives a review—approved, changes requested, or commented—so product managers can follow code review progress without needing GitHub access.

useCases.title: Failed CI notification on Jira tickets
useCases.description: When a GitHub Actions CI run fails on a PR, GAIA adds a flag or comment to the linked Jira ticket alerting the team that the build is broken, preventing the ticket from being marked Done prematurely.

useCases.title: Sprint completion report from merged PRs
useCases.description: At the end of a sprint, GAIA compiles all merged PRs and their linked Jira tickets into a structured summary, giving engineering managers an accurate picture of what was shipped without manually cross-referencing two tools.

howItWorks.step: Connect GitHub and Jira to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your GitHub repositories and Jira project in GAIA's integration settings. GAIA uses OAuth for both connections and only requests the permissions needed for issue and PR sync.

howItWorks.step: Map GitHub events to Jira transitions
howItWorks.description: Configure which GitHub PR events trigger which Jira transitions, how to link PRs to Jira issues (by branch name, PR title, or commit message), and which Jira project to target for new issues.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps GitHub and Jira synchronized automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both GitHub and Jira for changes and keeps them in sync automatically. You can override any automated action by telling GAIA directly, and all sync history is logged for audit purposes.

faqs.question: How does GAIA link a GitHub PR to the correct Jira ticket?
faqs.answer: GAIA looks for Jira issue keys (e.g., PROJ-123) in the PR title, branch name, or commit messages. If it finds a match, it links the PR to that Jira ticket automatically. You can also manually link a PR to a ticket via a GAIA command.

faqs.question: Can GAIA work with Jira's custom workflows and statuses?
faqs.answer: Yes. During setup GAIA reads your Jira project's workflow configuration and lets you map GitHub events to your specific custom statuses rather than assuming a generic To Do / In Progress / Done structure.

faqs.question: Does this work with Jira Cloud and Jira Server?
faqs.answer: GAIA supports Jira Cloud natively. Jira Server and Jira Data Center integrations are available with additional configuration and require network access to your self-hosted instance.

faqs.question: Will GAIA create duplicate Jira tickets if the same issue appears in multiple PRs?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA tracks the relationship between GitHub PRs and Jira tickets and updates the existing ticket rather than creating duplicates. Multiple PRs can be linked to the same Jira ticket with individual status updates per PR.

github-hubspot.tagline: Log deployment activity to HubSpot deals and notify sales when customer-facing features ship
github-hubspot.metaTitle: GitHub + HubSpot 연동: 릴리스를 CRM에 연결
github-hubspot.metaDescription: 요청된 기능이 출시되면 영업팀에 알리고, 릴리스를 CRM 타임라인에 기록합니다. GAIA가 고객 버그용 HubSpot 작업도 만듭니다. 설정 단계를 확인하세요.
github-hubspot.intro:
Sales and engineering teams operate in separate worlds—one focused on deals and customer relationships in HubSpot, the other tracking code and releases in GitHub. When a customer's requested feature finally ships, the sales rep who promised it often finds out days later, missing the opportunity to re-engage the prospect at exactly the right moment.

GAIA creates a live connection between GitHub and HubSpot so engineering releases automatically surface in your CRM. When a release is published in GitHub, GAIA logs it as an activity on relevant HubSpot deals and accounts, notifies the owning AE, and can even trigger a follow-up task to reach out to customers who requested that feature.

For product-led growth companies, this integration also lets you tie engagement signals from GitHub—like when an enterprise customer first uses a new API endpoint—back to the HubSpot contact record, giving your sales team richer context for their conversations.

useCases.title: Notify sales reps when requested features ship
useCases.description: When a GitHub release includes a feature linked to a HubSpot deal, GAIA notifies the deal owner with a summary of what shipped so they can immediately follow up with the customer at the ideal moment.

useCases.title: Log releases as CRM timeline activities
useCases.description: Every GitHub release is automatically logged as a timeline activity on relevant HubSpot company or deal records, giving sales and success teams a complete picture of what has been delivered to each customer.

useCases.title: Create HubSpot tasks for customer-impacting bugs
useCases.description: When a GitHub issue is labeled as a customer-impacting bug, GAIA creates a HubSpot task for the customer success manager assigned to the affected account, ensuring proactive outreach before the customer escalates.

useCases.title: Advance deal stages based on technical milestones
useCases.description: For enterprise deals with a technical evaluation phase, GAIA advances the HubSpot deal stage automatically when key GitHub milestones are reached, such as a proof-of-concept integration being merged.

useCases.title: Track GitHub engagement signals in HubSpot contacts
useCases.description: When a customer's GitHub organization forks your public repository or opens their first issue, GAIA logs this engagement signal in their HubSpot contact record so sales can reach out with perfectly timed outreach.

howItWorks.step: Connect GitHub and HubSpot to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your GitHub organization and HubSpot portal in GAIA's integration settings. GAIA requests read access to GitHub releases and issues, and write access to HubSpot activities and tasks.

howItWorks.step: Map GitHub events to HubSpot records
howItWorks.description: Define how GitHub releases map to HubSpot deals—by customer label, milestone name, or repository. Configure which events create tasks, log activities, or send notifications to deal owners.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps sales informed as code ships
howItWorks.description: Every time a relevant GitHub event occurs, GAIA updates the appropriate HubSpot records in real time. Your sales team always knows what was recently shipped and which customers are affected.

faqs.question: How does GAIA match a GitHub release to the right HubSpot deal?
faqs.answer: GAIA matches via customer or company labels on GitHub issues, release notes mentioning account names, or a mapping table you configure in GAIA's settings that associates repositories with specific HubSpot companies.

faqs.question: Can GAIA pull HubSpot deal data into GitHub for engineer context?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can add a comment to a GitHub issue with the relevant HubSpot deal stage and contact information, giving engineers context about which customers are waiting on a fix or feature.

faqs.question: Does this work with HubSpot's free tier?
faqs.answer: GAIA's GitHub-HubSpot integration works with HubSpot Starter and above. Some features like custom deal properties and advanced timeline activities require HubSpot Professional or Enterprise.

faqs.question: Can GAIA trigger HubSpot sequences when a feature ships?
faqs.answer: Yes. When a GitHub release is tagged, GAIA can enroll specified contacts in a HubSpot sequence automatically, enabling fully automated re-engagement campaigns timed to feature releases.

github-salesforce.tagline: GitHub 릴리스를 Salesforce 기회와 연결해 영업이 엔지니어링의 출시 내용을 항상 알게 하세요
github-salesforce.metaDescription: 약속한 기능이 출시되는 순간 계정 담당자가 알 수 있게 하세요. GAIA가 각 GitHub 릴리스를 해당 Salesforce 기회에 기록합니다.
github-salesforce.intro:
엔터프라이즈 영업 주기는 엔지니어링 약속에 달려 있는 경우가 많습니다. 잠재 고객이 계약 전에 특정 기능을 기다리거나, 갱신이 버그 수정 완료에 조건부로 걸려 있기도 합니다. 그러나 대부분의 조직에서 Salesforce 기회와 해당 업무를 추적하는 GitHub 마일스톤은 완전히 분리되어 있습니다. 계정 담당자는 자동화된 신뢰할 수 있는 알림 대신 Slack 메시지나 복도 대화로 릴리스를 알게 됩니다.

GAIA는 GitHub과 Salesforce 사이에 실시간 연결을 만들어 엔지니어링 결과물이 CRM에 자동으로 나타나게 합니다. 릴리스가 게시되면 GAIA가 관련 기회와 계정에 이벤트를 기록하고 담당 계정 담당자에게 알리며, 릴리스가 약속한 산출물을 충족하면 기회 단계를 진전시킬 수 있습니다.

엔터프라이즈 엔지니어링 팀에게 이 연동은 반대 방향으로도 작동합니다. 고액 기회가 수주 성공으로 표시되면 GAIA가 온보딩 업무를 위한 마일스톤을 만들어, 무엇을 약속했는지에 대한 전체 맥락과 함께 구현이 즉시 시작되게 합니다.

useCases.title: GitHub 릴리스를 Salesforce 기회 타임라인에 기록
useCases.description: 릴리스가 게시되면 GAIA가 해당 릴리스가 관련된 모든 기회에 활동을 만들어 계정 담당자가 무엇이 제공되었는지 실시간 기록을 확인할 수 있게 합니다.

useCases.title: 약속한 기능 출시 시 계정 담당자에게 알림
useCases.description: 기회와 연결된 마일스톤이 완료되면 GAIA가 앱 내 알림과 이메일을 계정 담당자에게 보내 잠재 고객에게 바로 후속 연락할 수 있게 합니다.

useCases.title: 기술 마일스톤에 따른 기회 단계 진전
useCases.description: 기술적 개념 검증 단계가 있는 딜의 경우 해당 마일스톤이 완료로 표시되면 GAIA가 기회 단계를 자동으로 올려 파이프라인 데이터를 정확하게 유지합니다.

useCases.title: 수주 성공 딜에서 GitHub 마일스톤 생성
useCases.description: 기회가 수주 성공으로 표시되면 GAIA가 딜의 핵심 산출물을 이슈로 담은 구현 업무 마일스톤을 만들어 엔지니어링 팀이 전체 맥락과 함께 시작하게 합니다.

useCases.title: 기회 가치에 따라 고객 버그 에스컬레이션
useCases.description: 이슈에 고객 계정이 태그되면 GAIA가 해당 계정의 기회 가치를 확인해 GitHub에서 이슈 우선순위를 그에 맞게 올립니다. 고액 고객의 버그가 가장 빠르게 처리됩니다.

howItWorks.description: GAIA 설정에서 GitHub 조직과 Salesforce 조직을 인증합니다. 두 연결 모두 OAuth를 사용하며 릴리스 기록과 기회 업데이트에 필요한 접근 수준만 요청합니다.
저장소와 마일스톤이 계정, 기회, 사용자 정의 객체에 어떻게 대응하는지 정의하세요. 명명 규칙, 라벨, 수동 매핑 표를 활용할 수 있습니다.
설정이 끝나면 GAIA가 릴리스와 마일스톤 이벤트를 모니터링하며 CRM을 실시간으로 업데이트해, 항상 현재 엔지니어링 산출물 상태를 반영하게 합니다.

faqs.question: Salesforce 사용자 정의 객체와 필드도 지원하나요?
faqs.answer: 네. 표준 객체는 물론 사용자 정의 객체와 필드도 읽고 쓸 수 있습니다. 설정 시 저장소의 이벤트 데이터를 조직의 어떤 필드에도 매핑할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: GAIA는 릴리스가 어느 계정에 영향을 주는지 어떻게 아나요?
faqs.answer: GAIA는 저장소나 이슈의 라벨, 릴리스 노트 내용, 또는 GAIA 설정에서 저장소를 특정 계정과 연결한 매핑 표를 기준으로 매칭합니다.

faqs.question: 플로우나 프로세스 빌더 규칙을 트리거할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: GAIA는 표준 API로 레코드를 업데이트하며, 이 과정에서 해당 객체에 설정된 자동화 규칙, 플로우, 프로세스 빌더 프로세스가 실행될 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 엄격한 데이터 정책을 쓰는 엔터프라이즈 조직에서도 안전한가요?
faqs.answer: 네. GAIA는 표준 연결 앱 방식의 OAuth 2.0을 사용합니다. CRM에는 소스 코드나 민감한 데이터가 저장되지 않으며 릴리스 이름, 날짜, 링크 같은 메타데이터만 기록됩니다.

github-teams.tagline: GitHub PR 업데이트 및 릴리스 알림을 Microsoft Teams 채널에 직접 게시
github-teams.metaTitle: GitHub + Microsoft Teams 연동: 개발 알림
github-teams.metaDescription: GAIA로 GitHub 및 Microsoft Teams를 연결합니다. PR 검토, 이슈 알림, 릴리스 공지를 Teams 채널에 게시하고 엔지니어링 팀을 최신 상태로 유지합니다.
github-teams.intro: Microsoft Teams는 많은 엔터프라이즈 엔지니어링 팀의 커뮤니케이션 허브이지만, GitHub 활동(PR 검토, 이슈 에스컬레이션, 릴리스 공지)은 수동 작업 없이는 거의 발생하지 않습니다. 개발자는 별도로 GitHub 알림을 모니터링하고, 중요한 업데이트를 Teams에 수동으로 복사하고, 보류 중인 코드 검토에 대해 팀원에게 상기시켜야 합니다. GAIA는 GitHub 이벤트를 Microsoft Teams로 자동화하여 전체 조직이 코드 활동에 대한 정보를 제공받도록 합니다. PR 검토 요청은 관련 Teams 채널에 나타나고, 릴리스 노트는 새 버전이 출시될 때 게시됩니다. 중요 버그는 팀이 Teams를 떠나지 않고도 처리할 수 있는 적응형 카드 알림을 트리거합니다. Teams를 표준으로 사용하는 엔터프라이즈 조직의 경우, 이 통합은 개발자 대면 GitHub 워크플로우와 더 넓은 비즈니스 커뮤니케이션 간의 격차를 해소하므로 비개발자가 GitHub를 직접 모니터링할 필요가 없습니다.

useCases.title: Teams에 PR 검토 알림 게시
useCases.description: GitHub에서 PR이 열리거나 업데이트되면 GAIA는 지정된 Teams 채널 또는 검토자의 DM에 PR 제목, 작성자 및 직접 링크를 포함하여 형식화된 카드에 게시하므로, 검토자가 즉시 요청을 볼 수 있습니다.

useCases.title: 변경 로그와 함께 릴리스 공지
useCases.description: GitHub 릴리스가 게시되면 GAIA는 엔지니어링 Teams 채널에 형식화된 공지 카드를 게시하고 버전 번호, 주요 변경 사항 및 전체 릴리스 노트 링크를 포함하므로, 팀은 새 버전에 대한 정보를 즉시 얻습니다.

useCases.title: 이슈에서 인시던트 알림
useCases.description: 프로덕션 인시던트로 레이블이 지정된 이슈는 온콜 채널에 즉각적인 Teams 알림을 트리거하므로, 별도 도구를 확인하지 않고도 올바른 담당자에게 페이지를 지정할 수 있습니다.

useCases.title: 일일 PR 상태 요약
useCases.description: GAIA는 오전 공지에서 열린 PR을 연령 및 검토자 할당별로 정렬하고 엔지니어링 Teams 채널에 게시하므로, 팀은 당일에 필요한 작업을 정확하게 알 수 있습니다.

useCases.title: 공유 리포지토리에 대한 교차 팀 가시성
useCases.description: 여러 팀이 유지 관리하는 리포지토리의 경우 GAIA는 변경된 파일 또는 적용된 라벨에 따라 알림을 적절한 Teams 채널로 라우팅하므로, 각 팀은 자신에게 관련된 활동만 볼 수 있습니다.

howItWorks.step: GitHub 및 Microsoft Teams를 GAIA에 연결
howItWorks.description: GitHub 조직 및 Teams 테넌트에 GAIA를 인증합니다. GAIA는 Teams에 대한 Azure AD OAuth 및 리포지토리 액세스에 대한 GitHub OAuth를 사용합니다.
어떤 리포지토리 및 이벤트 유형이 Teams 알림을 보내야 하는지 지정합니다. 다양한 이벤트 범주에 대한 적응형 카드 템플릿을 구성합니다.

howItWorks.step: GAIA는 GitHub 인텔리전스를 Teams에 자동으로 제공합니다
howItWorks.description: GAIA는 GitHub를 지속적으로 모니터링하고 적절한 형식화된 알림을 Teams에 게시합니다. 팀 구성원은 Teams를 떠나지 않고 알림에 응답하거나 작업할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: GAIA는 일반 텍스트 메시지 대신 Teams에 적응형 카드를 게시할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네, GAIA는 작업 단추(PR 승인, 이슈 닫기, GitHub로 직접 이동 등)를 포함하여 풍부한 구조화된 GitHub 알림을 Teams에 게시하는 Microsoft Adaptive Card 형식을 사용합니다.

faqs.question: GAIA는 Teams 개인 채널 및 게스트 액세스와 함께 작동하나요?
faqs.answer: GAIA 봇이 개인 채널에 추가되고 적절한 권한이 부여된 경우 공개 및 개인 Teams 채널에 게시할 수 있습니다. 게스트 액세스 권한은 존중되며 GAIA는 명시적으로 액세스 권한이 부여된 채널에만 게시합니다.

faqs.question: Teams 사용자는 Jira 계정 없이 Teams에서 GitHub 이슈를 관리할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네, 팀 구성원은 Teams에서 GAIA에게 직접 명령하여 Jira 이슈를 생성, 업데이트 또는 쿼리할 수 있습니다. GAIA는 스레드에서 작업을 실행하고 확인합니다.

faqs.question: 이것이 표준 Teams용 GitHub 앱과 어떻게 다른가요?
faqs.answer: 표준 GitHub 앱은 기본 알림을 제공합니다. GAIA는 스마트 상태 전환, CI 알림 및 브랜치 생성을 추가하는 더 지능적인 자동화를 제공합니다.

github-stripe.tagline: Coordinate billing feature releases with Stripe configuration and catch payment-related code risks before they ship
github-stripe.metaTitle: GitHub + Stripe 연동: 배포와 결제 변경 자동화
github-stripe.metaDescription: 결제 관련 변경을 놓치지 마세요. GAIA가 결제 코드를 건드리는 PR을 표시하고, Stripe 웹훅 실패로 이슈를 만듭니다. 설정 단계를 확인하세요.
github-stripe.intro:
Payment engineering is high stakes—a breaking change to Stripe integration code or a billing feature shipped without coordinated Stripe product configuration can result in failed charges, broken checkouts, and revenue loss. Yet many engineering teams manage their GitHub and Stripe workflows in complete isolation, without guardrails that catch dangerous coordination errors before they reach production.

GAIA connects GitHub and Stripe to add safety and coordination to payment engineering workflows. When a PR touches Stripe-related files, GAIA automatically flags it for extra review scrutiny and checks against current Stripe API versions. When a billing feature is deployed via a GitHub release, GAIA can verify that the corresponding Stripe product or price configuration has been updated before the release goes live.

For SaaS engineering teams, this integration provides the coordination layer between code deployments and billing infrastructure that currently relies on manual checklists and Slack reminders, replacing tribal knowledge with automated guardrails.

useCases.title: Flag PRs that touch payment code for extra review
useCases.description: When a pull request modifies files in payment-related directories or imports Stripe libraries, GAIA automatically adds a payment-sensitive label and assigns a designated payments reviewer, ensuring no billing change ships without proper scrutiny.

useCases.title: Verify Stripe config before billing feature releases
useCases.description: Before a GitHub release that includes billing changes goes live, GAIA checks that the required Stripe products, prices, and webhook endpoints are configured correctly in the target environment, alerting the team to any discrepancies.

useCases.title: Create GitHub issues from Stripe webhook failures
useCases.description: When Stripe webhook deliveries start failing, GAIA creates a GitHub issue in the relevant repository with the error details and a link to the Stripe dashboard, automatically assigning it to the payments team.

useCases.title: Track Stripe API version upgrades as GitHub issues
useCases.description: When Stripe announces a new API version, GAIA creates a GitHub issue in your billing repository with the breaking changes, migration guide link, and a suggested timeline based on Stripe's deprecation schedule.

useCases.title: Deployment rollback checklist for billing changes
useCases.description: When a GitHub release that touches billing code is deployed, GAIA creates a time-limited GitHub issue with a rollback checklist including Stripe-specific steps that stays open until the deployment is confirmed stable.

howItWorks.step: Connect GitHub and Stripe to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your GitHub repositories and Stripe account in GAIA's settings. GAIA uses restricted Stripe API keys with read-only access to the product catalog and webhook configuration.
Configure which directories or files are considered payment-sensitive, who the required reviewers are, what pre-release checks to run, and how to handle Stripe webhook failure alerts.

howItWorks.step: GAIA enforces payment engineering guardrails automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both GitHub and Stripe for relevant events and enforces the rules you've defined, creating issues, alerting reviewers, or notifying on-call as configured without manual intervention.

faqs.question: Can GAIA prevent a GitHub release from deploying if Stripe config is wrong?
faqs.answer: GAIA can block a GitHub Actions deployment step by failing a pre-deployment check and posting the configuration discrepancies as a PR comment. Actual deployment gating requires integrating GAIA's check into your CI/CD pipeline.

faqs.question: Does GAIA need full Stripe account access?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA uses restricted Stripe API keys with read-only access to products, prices, and webhook endpoints. GAIA never needs access to customer payment data or live charge records.

faqs.question: Can GAIA help us track which Stripe API version we're on?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can scan your codebase for the Stripe API version pinned in your configuration files and compare it against the current Stripe API version, creating a GitHub issue when you're running behind on upgrades.

faqs.question: Does this work for both Stripe test mode and live mode?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can be configured to monitor your Stripe test environment for staging deployments and your live environment for production releases, with separate alerting thresholds for each.

github-airtable.tagline: Sync GitHub issues and PRs to Airtable so your project database always reflects your code reality
github-airtable.metaTitle: GitHub + Airtable 연동: 이슈를 프로젝트 DB에 동기화
github-airtable.metaDescription: GitHub 이슈를 Airtable 로드맵 베이스에 동기화하고, PR 사이클 타임과 릴리스를 기록합니다. GAIA가 맞춤 리포트를 만듭니다. 설정 단계를 확인하세요.
github-airtable.intro:
Airtable's flexible database structure makes it the go-to tool for custom project tracking, roadmapping, and engineering metrics—but keeping an Airtable base in sync with GitHub is a manual, time-consuming process. Issues get logged in GitHub but never make it to the roadmap base. PRs are merged but the corresponding Airtable record stays stuck in In Progress. Leadership dashboards built in Airtable are always a few days behind reality.

GAIA syncs GitHub and Airtable in real time so your custom project databases are always accurate. Issues created in GitHub appear in your Airtable roadmap base automatically. PR status changes update the corresponding Airtable record. Releases trigger new rows in your release tracking base with the relevant metadata.

For product-engineering teams that have built custom Airtable workflows for planning and reporting, this integration removes the manual data entry burden that makes those workflows unsustainable at scale.

useCases.title: Sync GitHub issues to an Airtable roadmap base
useCases.description: When a GitHub issue is created or updated, GAIA creates or updates the corresponding record in your Airtable roadmap base, mapping issue fields like labels, assignees, and milestones to your custom Airtable columns.

useCases.title: Track PR cycle time in Airtable
useCases.description: GAIA records PR open and merge timestamps in an Airtable base, enabling you to build custom views and formulas that track engineering cycle time, review duration, and throughput metrics without manual data collection.

useCases.title: Update release tracking base on GitHub releases
useCases.description: When a GitHub release is published, GAIA adds a new record to your Airtable release tracking base with the version number, date, number of issues closed, and a link to the release notes.

useCases.title: Weekly engineering metrics compiled into Airtable
useCases.description: GAIA compiles weekly engineering metrics—issues opened and closed, PRs merged, releases shipped—into an Airtable summary record that feeds your leadership reporting views automatically.

useCases.title: Map GitHub labels to Airtable select fields
useCases.description: GitHub issue labels like priority::high or type::bug are automatically mapped to corresponding Airtable single-select or multi-select fields, ensuring your database categorization stays consistent with GitHub's labeling system.

howItWorks.step: Connect GitHub and Airtable to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize your GitHub repositories and Airtable workspace in GAIA's settings. Specify which Airtable base and table to sync with each GitHub repository.

howItWorks.step: Map GitHub fields to Airtable columns
howItWorks.description: Configure how GitHub data maps to your Airtable schema—which GitHub fields populate which Airtable columns, how to handle new GitHub labels, and whether to create new records or update existing ones.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps your Airtable base synchronized with GitHub
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors GitHub for issue, PR, and release events and updates your Airtable base in real time. Your dashboards and views always reflect current GitHub data without manual imports.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync data from Airtable back to GitHub?
faqs.answer: Yes. Two-way sync is supported—if you update an issue status in Airtable, GAIA can update the corresponding GitHub issue label or assignee. This is useful for product managers who manage priority in Airtable but want changes reflected in GitHub.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work with Airtable's linked records feature?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can create linked records in Airtable—for example, linking a PR record to the issue records it closes—preserving the relational structure of your data rather than flattening everything into a single table.

faqs.question: Can I use Airtable automations alongside GAIA's sync?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA's record updates trigger Airtable's native automations just like manual edits do, so you can combine GAIA's GitHub sync with Airtable's own automation features for additional downstream actions.

faqs.question: How does GAIA handle GitHub issues that are deleted?
faqs.answer: When a GitHub issue is deleted, GAIA can either delete the corresponding Airtable record, mark it as deleted in a status field, or leave it as an archived record—depending on your configuration preference.

github-loom.tagline: Attach Loom walkthroughs to PRs and auto-request video reviews for complex code changes
github-loom.metaTitle: GitHub + Loom 연동: 영상 코드 리뷰와 PR 설명
github-loom.metaDescription: 큰 PR에는 Loom 녹화를 요청하고, Loom 링크를 미리보기로 보여주며, 버그 영상으로 이슈를 만듭니다. GAIA가 리뷰를 쉽게 만듭니다. 설정 단계를 확인하세요.
github-loom.intro:
Complex pull requests are notoriously hard to review from code alone. A PR that refactors a core service, introduces a new architecture pattern, or changes subtle UX behavior is difficult to understand through diff reading, leading to slow or shallow reviews and frequently missed issues. Engineers end up in long Zoom calls just to explain a change that could have been covered in a three-minute Loom video.

GAIA connects GitHub and Loom to make async code review richer and more efficient. When a large or complex PR is opened, GAIA prompts the author to record a Loom walkthrough and attaches the video link to the PR automatically. When a reviewer requests changes, GAIA can suggest recording a Loom to explain the feedback rather than writing a lengthy comment thread. When a Loom documenting a bug is shared with GAIA, it creates the corresponding GitHub issue with the video embedded.

For distributed engineering teams that rely on async communication, this integration bridges the gap between recorded video explanations and the GitHub code review workflow, reducing time-to-review and improving the quality of feedback on complex changes.

useCases.title: Prompt PR authors to record a Loom for large changes
useCases.description: When a PR exceeds a configured number of changed lines or files, GAIA posts a comment prompting the author to record a Loom walkthrough and providing a direct link to create one, improving review quality for complex changes.

useCases.title: Auto-format Loom links in PR descriptions as previews
useCases.description: When a Loom URL is included anywhere in a PR description or comment, GAIA formats it as a prominent preview card at the top of the PR so reviewers immediately see there's a video walkthrough available.

useCases.title: Create GitHub issues from Loom bug recordings
useCases.description: When a team member records a Loom video documenting a bug and shares it via GAIA, GAIA creates a GitHub issue with the Loom video embedded, the transcript as the issue body, and automatic label assignment.

useCases.title: Request Loom explanations for complex review comments
useCases.description: When a reviewer leaves a complex change request on a PR, GAIA suggests they record a Loom to explain the concern, resulting in clearer feedback and faster resolution than back-and-forth text threads.

useCases.title: Build a Loom walkthrough library from merged PRs
useCases.description: GAIA maintains a collection of Loom walkthroughs attached to merged PRs, organized by date and feature area, so new team members have a video library of how the codebase evolved over time.

howItWorks.step: Connect GitHub and Loom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize your GitHub repositories and Loom workspace in GAIA's settings. GAIA uses GitHub's API for PR interactions and Loom's API to access and embed video metadata.
Set the PR size threshold that triggers a walkthrough prompt, define which repositories require video reviews for specific file types, and configure how Loom links are displayed in PRs.

howItWorks.step: GAIA makes video a first-class part of code review
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors PR creation and updates, prompts for Looms when helpful, embeds video links prominently, and maintains a searchable index of PR walkthroughs for your team.

faqs.question: Does GAIA actually embed the Loom video in GitHub or just link to it?
faqs.answer: GitHub doesn't support embedded video playback in PR descriptions. GAIA formats the Loom link as a prominent thumbnail preview using Loom's embed URL, which shows the video title and a preview image with a clear link to watch it.

faqs.question: Can GAIA use Loom transcripts to summarize a PR for non-technical reviewers?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can extract the auto-generated Loom transcript and create a plain-language summary of the walkthrough, which it can post to Slack or include in a Jira ticket for stakeholders who don't read code.

faqs.question: Is this useful for teams that don't currently do video reviews?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. GAIA's prompts are configurable—you can start with only suggesting Looms for very large PRs or specific repositories, gradually normalizing the practice without overwhelming the team with new process requirements.

faqs.question: Can GAIA notify a reviewer when a new Loom walkthrough is added to a PR?
faqs.answer: Yes. When a Loom link is added to a PR that already has pending reviewers, GAIA sends a notification to the assigned reviewers alerting them that a walkthrough has been posted, often prompting faster review.

notion-jira.tagline: Sync Notion project docs with Jira issues so your specs and sprint tickets always match
notion-jira.metaTitle: Notion + Jira Integration - Sync Specs and Sprint Tickets
notion-jira.metaDescription: Connect Notion and Jira with GAIA. Sync spec pages to Jira epics, create tickets from Notion requirements, and keep your docs aligned with your sprint board.
notion-jira.intro:
Product and engineering teams frequently maintain separate workspaces for the same information—requirements live in Notion pages while the corresponding Jira epics and tickets are maintained independently. When the Notion spec changes, the Jira tickets rarely update to match. When a Jira ticket's scope evolves during development, the Notion document doesn't reflect the change. Teams spend hours reconciling two sets of documentation that should be in sync.

GAIA bridges Notion and Jira so that documentation and project tracking reinforce each other rather than drifting apart. When a Notion requirements page is finalized, GAIA can generate the corresponding Jira epic and user stories automatically. When a Jira ticket is updated with new acceptance criteria, GAIA updates the linked Notion section. When a sprint closes in Jira, GAIA updates the Notion project doc with the outcomes.

For product-engineering teams that use Notion as their spec repository and Jira as their sprint board, this integration eliminates the manual overhead of maintaining parallel documentation, ensuring that everyone—regardless of which tool they prefer—has access to accurate, current information.

useCases.title: Generate Jira epics and stories from Notion specs
useCases.description: When a Notion requirements page is marked as ready for development, GAIA reads the document structure and creates a corresponding Jira epic with user stories derived from the spec's sections, saving hours of ticket creation work.

useCases.title: Sync Jira ticket status back to Notion project pages
useCases.description: GAIA monitors Jira for status changes and updates the corresponding Notion database records or inline callouts, so the Notion project page always reflects which features are in development, in review, or shipped.

useCases.title: Create Notion meeting notes linked to Jira tickets
useCases.description: When a Jira ticket is discussed in a meeting, GAIA creates a linked Notion page for meeting notes with the ticket context pre-filled, ensuring decisions and discussions are captured alongside the work being tracked.

useCases.title: Sprint retrospective doc from closed Jira tickets
useCases.description: At sprint end, GAIA compiles all closed Jira tickets into a structured Notion retrospective page including ticket titles, assignees, and story points, giving the team a ready-made foundation for their retro discussion.

useCases.title: Update Notion roadmap from Jira milestone completions
useCases.description: When a Jira version or fix version is released, GAIA updates the corresponding row in your Notion roadmap database, marking the milestone as shipped and adding the release date automatically.

howItWorks.step: Connect Notion and Jira to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize your Notion workspace and Jira project in GAIA's integration settings. GAIA requests read and write access to specific Notion databases and Jira projects you designate.

howItWorks.step: Map Notion pages to Jira objects
howItWorks.description: Define which Notion databases correspond to which Jira projects, how Notion properties map to Jira fields, and which triggers—like a Notion status change—should create or update Jira tickets.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps your docs and tickets in sync
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both Notion and Jira for changes and synchronizes them according to your configuration, ensuring that documentation and project tracking always reflect the same reality.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create Notion pages from Jira epics that already exist?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can run an initial import that creates Notion pages for existing Jira epics, allowing you to establish the sync relationship even if Jira was already populated before you set up the integration.

faqs.question: Does GAIA handle rich text formatting when converting between Notion and Jira?
faqs.answer: GAIA converts Notion's rich text blocks to Jira's wiki markup and vice versa, preserving headings, lists, code blocks, and basic formatting. Complex Notion page layouts are simplified to flat Jira descriptions.

faqs.question: What happens when a Jira ticket is deleted—does GAIA delete the Notion page?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA does not delete Notion pages when a Jira ticket is removed. Instead, it marks the linked Notion record as archived or removes the Jira link property, leaving the documentation intact.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync comments between Notion and Jira?
faqs.answer: GAIA can sync Jira comments to Notion page comments and vice versa, but comment sync is optional and off by default to avoid cluttering either tool with duplicate discussion threads.

notion-salesforce.tagline: Salesforce 계정 데이터를 Notion 위키로 동기화해 팀이 항상 최신 고객 맥락을 갖게 하세요
notion-salesforce.metaTitle: Salesforce Notion 연동: 딜에서 고객 위키로
notion-salesforce.metaDescription: 수주 성공 딜에서 Notion 고객 위키를 만들고 회의 노트를 Salesforce에 기록합니다. GAIA가 계정 데이터를 동기화합니다.
notion-salesforce.intro:
Salesforce에는 회사의 가장 값진 고객 데이터가 있지만, 사람이 읽기 좋게가 아니라 CRM 워크플로우에 맞춰 구조화되어 있습니다. 고객 이력을 파악해야 하는 계정 관리자, 딜에서 어떤 기능을 약속했는지 알아야 하는 제품팀, 새 계정을 브리핑해야 하는 온보딩 팀 모두 필드가 많은 인터페이스에서 필요한 지식을 끌어내는 데 어려움을 겪습니다.

GAIA는 정형 계정 데이터에서 읽기 쉽고 정리된 지식을 자동 생성해 CRM과 Notion을 연결합니다. 기회가 성사되면 딜 세부 정보, 핵심 연락처, 약속한 산출물을 담은 고객 위키를 만듭니다. 계정 데이터가 바뀌면 해당 페이지가 자동으로 업데이트됩니다.

고객 성공, 솔루션 엔지니어링, 제품팀에게 이 연동은 Salesforce를 기록 시스템에서 모두가 매일 쓰는 도구에서 접근할 수 있는 읽기 쉽고 실행 가능한 지식의 원천으로 바꿔 줍니다.

useCases.title: 수주 성공 딜에서 고객 위키 자동 생성
useCases.description: 기회가 수주 성공으로 표시되면 GAIA가 계정 세부 정보, 핵심 연락처, 딜 조건, 빈 온보딩 체크리스트를 담은 새 고객용 구조화 페이지를 만듭니다.

useCases.title: 계정 상태 데이터를 Notion 대시보드로 동기화
useCases.description: GAIA가 갱신일, ARR, 제품 등급, 지원 등급 같은 Salesforce 계정 상태 지표를 데이터베이스로 가져옵니다. 고객 성공팀이 도구를 오가지 않고 실시간 대시보드를 볼 수 있습니다.

useCases.title: Salesforce 기회에서 회의 준비 페이지 생성
useCases.description: 기회가 핵심 단계에 이르기 전 GAIA가 기회 이력, 연락처 정보, 이전 회의 노트를 담은 회의 준비 페이지를 만들어 계정 담당자가 충분히 브리핑된 상태로 임하게 합니다.

useCases.title: 회의 노트를 Salesforce 활동에 기록
useCases.description: Notion에서 회의 노트가 완성되면 GAIA가 관련 기회나 계정 레코드에 대응하는 활동 로그를 만들어, 계정 담당자가 같은 내용을 두 번 입력하지 않아도 CRM이 최신으로 유지됩니다.

useCases.title: 기회 노트로 Notion 제품 피드백 데이터베이스 업데이트
useCases.description: GAIA가 기회 노트와 통화 기록에서 제품 피드백 언급을 찾아 제품 피드백 데이터베이스에 추가합니다. 제품팀이 고객이 요청하는 내용을 구조화된 형태로 볼 수 있습니다.

howItWorks.description: GAIA 설정에서 Notion 워크스페이스와 Salesforce 조직을 인증합니다. 어떤 객체(계정, 기회, 연락처)를 어떤 데이터베이스와 동기화할지 지정하세요.
어떤 CRM 이벤트가 페이지를 만들거나 업데이트할지, CRM 필드가 페이지 속성에 어떻게 매핑되는지, 어떤 데이터베이스 변경이 활동에 다시 기록되어야 하는지 정의하세요.

howItWorks.step: GAIA가 CRM 데이터를 접근 가능한 지식으로 변환
howItWorks.description: GAIA가 설정한 트리거를 CRM에서 모니터링하며 해당 페이지를 자동으로 만들거나 업데이트합니다. 팀이 항상 읽기 쉬운 형식으로 최신 고객 맥락을 갖게 됩니다.

faqs.question: Salesforce 사용자 정의 필드를 Notion으로 가져올 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네. 설정 시 GAIA가 사용자 정의 필드와 객체를 포함한 객체 스키마를 읽으므로 CRM 데이터를 데이터베이스의 페이지 속성에 자유롭게 매핑할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: CRM으로의 동기화는 실시간인가요, 주기적인가요?
faqs.answer: CRM에서 페이지로의 동기화는 이벤트 기반으로 거의 실시간입니다. 페이지에서 CRM으로의 동기화(예: 회의 노트 기록)는 사용자가 직접 트리거하거나 페이지가 지정된 상태에 도달하면 자동으로 실행할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: GAIA가 민감한 CRM 데이터를 권한 없는 워크스페이스 멤버에게 노출하나요?
faqs.answer: GAIA는 지정한 페이지와 데이터베이스에만 기록하며 기존 권한 모델을 따릅니다. 페이지가 특정 멤버로 제한되어 있으면 그 멤버만 CRM에서 가져온 콘텐츠를 볼 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 여러 계정 레코드를 하나의 페이지에 매핑할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네. 상위·하위 계정처럼 여러 계정 레코드가 있는 고객의 경우 설정한 구조에 따라 관련 데이터를 하나의 페이지로 통합하거나 연결된 하위 페이지를 만들 수 있습니다.

notion-loom.tagline: Loom 영상을 Notion 페이지에 자동 삽입하고 영상 스크립트로 문서를 만드세요
notion-loom.metaTitle: Notion + Loom 연동: 검색 가능한 영상 지식 베이스
notion-loom.metaDescription: Loom 녹화를 주제별 Notion 페이지에 삽입하고 스크립트를 문서로 바꿉니다. GAIA가 검색 가능한 영상 라이브러리를 만듭니다.
notion-loom.intro:
Loom 영상은 제품 안내, 디자인 리뷰, 프로세스 설명처럼 글로는 담기 어려운 지식을 기록합니다. 하지만 영상 콘텐츠는 검색하고 정리하기가 매우 어렵습니다. 녹화는 가장 많은 맥락을 제공할 관련 Notion 페이지와 연결되지 않은 채 쌓입니다. 영상으로 공유된 지식은 누구도 문서와 연결하지 않아 새 팀원이 합류하면 사라집니다.

GAIA는 두 도구를 연결해 영상 지식과 문서 지식이 서로를 보강하게 합니다. Loom을 녹화해 GAIA에 공유하면 영상 제목과 내용에 따라 관련 페이지에 자동 삽입됩니다. 스크립트를 추출해 구조화된 문서를 생성할 수도 있어 영상 지식을 검색하고 훑어볼 수 있습니다.

비동기 영상 소통에 크게 의존하는 팀에게 이 연동은 흩어진 녹화 모음을 Notion에 기반한 구조화되고 검색 가능한 지식 베이스로 바꿔, 영상으로 공유된 중요한 지식이 사라지지 않게 합니다.

useCases.title: 주제별로 Loom 녹화를 Notion 페이지에 자동 삽입
useCases.description: 영상이 녹화되고 프로젝트명이나 주제 태그가 붙으면 GAIA가 관련 Notion 페이지를 찾아 전용 녹화 섹션에 삽입합니다. 영상 콘텐츠가 문서 맥락과 함께 정리됩니다.

useCases.title: Loom 스크립트로 문서 생성
useCases.description: GAIA가 Loom의 자동 스크립트를 추출해 제목, 글머리 기호, 실행 항목이 있는 페이지로 구조화합니다. 보는 것보다 읽는 것을 선호하는 사람도 영상 내용을 검색하고 훑어볼 수 있습니다.

useCases.title: 회의 영상에서 Notion 실행 항목 페이지 생성
useCases.description: 회의 업데이트나 프로젝트 리뷰 영상이 녹화되면 GAIA가 스크립트에서 언급된 실행 항목을 찾아 항목 목록, 제안 담당자, 원본 영상이 포함된 작업 페이지를 만듭니다.

useCases.title: 검색 가능한 온보딩 영상 라이브러리 구축
useCases.description: GAIA가 온보딩 콘텐츠로 태그된 녹화를 제목, 설명, 발표자, 길이, 직접 삽입과 함께 전용 데이터베이스에 자동 분류합니다. 스스로 갱신되는 신입 사원 자료 라이브러리가 만들어집니다.

useCases.title: 디자인 안내 영상을 기획서에 연결
useCases.description: 디자이너가 새 디자인 안내 영상을 녹화하면 GAIA가 영상을 해당 기획서 페이지에 연결하고 안내 내용 요약을 페이지 댓글로 추가합니다. 디자인 결정이 기획서와 함께 문서화됩니다.

howItWorks.description: GAIA 연동 설정에서 Notion 워크스페이스와 Loom 계정을 승인합니다. 영상과 스크립트를 받을 데이터베이스를 지정하세요.

howItWorks.step: 영상 라우팅 및 스크립트 규칙 설정
howItWorks.description: 영상 제목, 태그, 워크스페이스 폴더를 기준으로 영상을 페이지에 어떻게 매칭할지 정의하고, GAIA가 영상을 삽입할지, 스크립트 문서를 만들지, 실행 항목을 추출할지, 세 가지를 모두 할지 설정하세요.

howItWorks.step: GAIA가 영상 지식 베이스를 자동 구축
howItWorks.description: 영상이 녹화되고 처리되면 GAIA가 적절한 페이지로 전달하고 설정된 문서를 생성합니다. 팀이 계속 녹화하는 만큼 지식 베이스가 자동으로 성장합니다.

faqs.question: GAIA가 Loom 영상을 페이지에 직접 삽입하나요, 아니면 링크만 넣나요?
faqs.answer: GAIA는 삽입 블록으로 영상을 페이지에 직접 넣어 페이지를 떠나지 않고 시청할 수 있게 합니다. 외부 링크가 아니라 페이지 안에서 재생되는 인라인 임베드로 표시됩니다.

faqs.question: GAIA가 활용하는 자동 스크립트는 얼마나 정확한가요?
faqs.answer: 스크립트는 일반적으로 명확한 발음에서 정확하지만 기술 용어나 강한 억양은 약간 수정이 필요할 수 있습니다. GAIA의 스크립트-페이지 변환 기능은 구조화된 콘텐츠와 명확히 언급된 실행 항목에서 잘 작동합니다.

faqs.question: 기존 영상이 많이 쌓여 있어도 처리할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네. GAIA가 기존 라이브러리를 초기 일괄 가져오기로 처리해 각 영상의 페이지나 데이터베이스 항목을 만들 수 있습니다. 날짜 범위, 워크스페이스 폴더, 제작자로 가져올 영상을 필터링할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 하나의 영상이 여러 Notion 페이지에 속하면 어떻게 되나요?
faqs.answer: 영상 태그나 내용이 여러 페이지와 일치하면 GAIA가 같은 영상을 여러 페이지에 삽입할 수 있습니다. GAIA로 영상을 공유할 때 여러 대상 페이지를 직접 지정할 수도 있습니다.

todoist-jira.tagline: Sync personal Todoist tasks with Jira tickets without leaving your flow
todoist-jira.metaTitle: Todoist + Jira Integration - Personal Tasks Meet Team Tickets
todoist-jira.metaDescription: Connect Todoist and Jira with GAIA. Automatically create Jira issues from Todoist tasks, sync your assigned Jira tickets into Todoist, and keep your personal and team workflows aligned.
todoist-jira.intro:
Software teams track engineering work in Jira, but individual contributors often capture their own action items, research notes, and follow-ups in a personal task manager like Todoist. These two systems rarely talk to each other, creating a fragmented picture of what actually needs to get done. Engineers end up maintaining two lists, manually copying ticket references into Todoist and hoping they stay in sync.

GAIA eliminates this duplication by acting as a live bridge between Todoist and Jira. When you're assigned a new Jira ticket, GAIA can add it to your Todoist inbox with the ticket number, priority, and due date pre-filled. When you capture a task in Todoist that belongs in Jira, GAIA can escalate it to the appropriate project and link the two records together. Status updates flow in both directions so you always see a single source of truth.

This integration is particularly valuable for engineers who prefer Todoist's fast capture and GTD-style organization but need to stay accountable within a team Jira workflow, and for project leads who want a personal view of their Jira workload alongside non-engineering tasks.

useCases.title: Mirror assigned Jira tickets into Todoist
useCases.description: GAIA watches for new Jira tickets assigned to you and immediately creates a matching Todoist task with the ticket ID, summary, priority level, and a direct link back to Jira so you can triage from your personal inbox.

useCases.title: Escalate Todoist tasks to Jira issues
useCases.description: When a task captured in Todoist grows in scope or needs team visibility, tell GAIA to promote it to a Jira issue. GAIA creates the ticket in the right project, sets the reporter, and updates the Todoist task with the Jira link.

useCases.title: Sync Jira status changes back to Todoist
useCases.description: When a Jira ticket moves to Done or is closed by a teammate, GAIA automatically marks the corresponding Todoist task complete so your personal list stays accurate without manual cleanup.

useCases.title: Daily sprint task briefing
useCases.description: Each morning GAIA compiles your active Jira sprint tickets and any related Todoist tasks into a single prioritized list, giving you a clear picture of what requires attention before your standup.

useCases.title: Bug report task capture
useCases.description: When you notice a bug while working and jot it down in Todoist, GAIA can instantly create a Jira bug ticket with the right issue type, component, and severity, keeping your development workflow uninterrupted.

howItWorks.step: Connect Todoist and Jira to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Todoist account and Jira workspace in GAIA's integration settings. GAIA uses OAuth for Todoist and Jira's REST API with scoped permissions so only your assigned projects and tasks are accessible.

howItWorks.step: Configure sync rules and project mappings
howItWorks.description: Tell GAIA which Jira projects map to which Todoist projects, what priority thresholds trigger sync, and whether you want bidirectional or one-way mirroring. You can express these rules in plain language.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps both systems in sync automatically
howItWorks.description: From that point on, GAIA monitors both Todoist and Jira for changes and propagates updates in real time. You can also trigger manual syncs or ask GAIA to report on discrepancies between the two systems.

faqs.question: Will GAIA sync all Jira tickets or only tickets assigned to me?
faqs.answer: By default GAIA only syncs Jira tickets assigned to your account, keeping your Todoist inbox focused on your personal workload. You can expand the scope to include tickets you're watching or tickets in a specific sprint if needed.

faqs.question: Can GAIA handle custom Jira fields when creating issues from Todoist?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can map Todoist task labels and priority levels to custom Jira fields during setup. GAIA will populate those fields when escalating Todoist tasks to Jira issues, respecting your team's required fields and workflows.

faqs.question: What happens if a Todoist task is edited after a Jira issue is created?
faqs.answer: GAIA can propagate title and description edits from Todoist to the linked Jira issue and vice versa. You control which fields are kept in sync and which are treated as independent to avoid unintended overwrites.

faqs.question: GAIA가 ClickUp의 사용자 지정 할 일 상태를 지원하나요?

faqs.answer: 물론입니다. 동기화에 참여할 프로젝트를 정확히 고릅니다. 장보기·개인 목표 같은 개인 프로젝트는 개인 앱에만 두고, 업무 프로젝트는 관련 팀 스페이스에 연결합니다.
faqs.question: 특정 Todoist 프로젝트만 동기화할 수 있나요?

faqs.answer: GAIA가 짝 할 일 사이 관계를 추적하려고 고유 연결 식별자를 씁니다. 짧은 디바운스 기간과 함께 마지막 쓰기 우선 논리로 동시 수정을 해결하고, 자동 해결이 안 되는 충돌은 알려줍니다.
faqs.question: 두 도구가 동시에 업데이트하면 GAIA가 중복 할 일을 만들나요?

howItWorks.description: GAIA의 연동 설정에서 두 계정을 인증하세요. GAIA가 안전 접근용으로 OAuth를 쓰고 지정한 워크스페이스·프로젝트 권한만 요청합니다.
어떤 개인 프로젝트가 팀 스페이스·목록에 해당하는지 정하세요. GAIA가 할 일을 팀 워크스페이스로 자동 올리는 규칙을 정합니다. 예를 들어 특정 라벨이 붙거나 특정 우선순위가 된 할 일이 기준입니다.
GAIA가 양쪽의 새 할 일, 배정, 상태 변경을 감시해 업데이트를 자동 전파하므로 개인·팀 화면이 항상 같은 현실을 반영합니다.
howItWorks.step: GAIA가 할 일을 양방향으로 계속 동기화

todoist-clickup.intro:
ClickUp은 풍부한 계층, 사용자 지정 필드, 보고 기능의 팀 프로젝트 관리를 제공합니다. Todoist는 빠르고 마찰 없는 수집이 필요할 때 개인이 찾는 개인 할 일 관리자입니다. 많은 전문가가 팀과는 프로젝트 관리자에서 협업하면서도 개인 GTD식 받은편지함은 개인용에 기대어 개인 의도와 팀 가시 약속 사이의 끈질긴 간격을 만듭니다.

GAIA가 둘 사이의 지능적 중계로 이 간격을 잇습니다. Todoist에 챙긴 개인 할 일은 팀 가시성이 필요할 때 올바른 목록·메타데이터의 ClickUp 할 일로 올릴 수 있습니다. 배정된 할 일은 개인 받은편지함으로 흘러 검토가 한곳에서 일어납니다. 상태 업데이트가 양방향으로 전파되어 어느 쪽도 뒤처지지 않습니다.

팀이 기대하는 워크플로우를 버리지 않고도 개인 수집 도구를 원하는 개인 기여자와, 행동은 비공개로 추적하면서도 책임용으로 팀에 보여야 하는 매니저에게 맞습니다.
todoist-clickup.metaDescription: Todoist에서 할 일을 챙기고 ClickUp에서 실행하세요. 완료는 양방향 동기화됩니다. GAIA가 배정 업무를 가져옵니다. 설정 방법을 확인하세요.

todoist-clickup.tagline: Todoist의 개인 할 일 수집과 ClickUp의 팀 프로젝트 관리를 연결하세요

todoist-trello.intro:
Trello의 시각 칸반 보드는 공유 업무 추적의 팀 기본이지만, 많은 개인이 자신의 할 일 관리에 Todoist의 목록 화면을 선호합니다. 문제는 거기서 비공개로 챙긴 업무가 제때 팀 보드에 오르는 일이 드물어 약속한 것과 팀이 볼 수 있는 것 사이에 간격이 생긴다는 것입니다.

GAIA가 둘을 연결해 할 일이 자동으로 오가게 합니다. Todoist 할 일이 팀 공유 준비가 되면 GAIA가 올바른 보드·목록에 설명, 마감일, 라벨이 완비된 Trello 카드를 만들 수 있습니다. 카드가 배정되면 GAIA가 추적용으로 개인 받은편지함에 가져올 수 있습니다. 완료·보관 조치가 양방향으로 전파되어 어느 쪽도 낡지 않습니다.

공유 보드를 프로젝트 화면으로 쓰면서 개인이 선호하는 개인 도구를 쓰게 하는 작은 팀, 업무는 비공개로 관리하면서 보드에서 고객과 진행을 공유하는 프리랜서에 맞습니다.
