faqs.answer: GAIA가 각 프로젝트를 만든 특정 기회에 연결합니다. 계정 수준 요약이 연결된 모든 프로젝트를 모아 계정 매니저가 완전한 납품 그림을 봅니다.
faqs.question: GAIA가 활성 프로젝트가 여러 개인 계정은 어떻게 처리하나요?

faqs.answer: GAIA가 CRM의 계약 금액을 읽어 예산 추적용으로 사용자 지정 프로젝트 필드를 채울 수 있습니다. 계획 대비 실제 예산 분석은 재무 데이터 원천 연결도 필요합니다.
faqs.question: GAIA가 프로젝트 예산을 기회 금액에 동기화할 수 있나요?

howItWorks.description: 워크스페이스·조직 접근을 GAIA에 승인하세요. 기회 필드를 프로젝트 필드에 매핑해 데이터가 두 도구 사이 정확히 옮겨지게 하세요.
어떤 기회 단계가 프로젝트 만들기를 일으키는지, 어떤 마일스톤 이벤트가 CRM 기록을 업데이트하는지, 계정이 프로젝트에 어떻게 연결되는지 정하세요.
GAIA가 두 도구를 감시해 관련 이벤트를 양방향으로 전파하므로 영업과 납품팀이 항상 정확하고 최신인 각 고객 관계 화면을 공유합니다.

asana-salesforce.intro:
영업팀이 Salesforce에서 거래를 성사시키는 동안 납품팀이 Asana에서 프로젝트를 실행하지만 둘은 대화를 나누는 일이 드뭅니다. 계정 매니저가 납품팀에 직접 묻지 않고는 프로젝트 납품 상태를 못 봅니다. 납품팀은 CRM에 사는 계정 맥락이 없습니다. 그 결과 팔린 것과 납품되는 것 사이의 간격이 생기고 두 팀이 불완전한 정보로 일합니다.

GAIA가 둘 사이를 연결해 프로젝트 납품과 고객 관계 관리가 함께 움직입니다. 기회가 성사되면 GAIA가 올바른 구조의 프로젝트를 자동 만들고 납품팀을 지정합니다. 프로젝트 마일스톤에 이르면 GAIA가 계정 기록을 업데이트해 계정 매니저가 프로젝트팀을 방해하지 않고도 납품 위치를 항상 압니다.

영업 약속과 프로젝트 납품의 촘촘한 일치가 필요한 전문 서비스 기업, 실행팀이 있는 SaaS 기업, 에이전시에 중요합니다.

trello-notion.tagline: Embed Trello boards in Notion and sync cards to Notion databases automatically
trello-notion.metaTitle: Trello + Notion Automation - Connect Boards to Your Knowledge Base
trello-notion.metaDescription: Bridge Trello and Notion with GAIA. Sync Trello cards to Notion databases, embed board status in Notion project pages, and keep your knowledge base and task management in perfect alignment.
trello-notion.intro:
Trello and Notion serve complementary purposes — Trello for visual task management and Notion for documentation, wikis, and project knowledge bases. But when teams run both, Trello cards and Notion pages diverge quickly. A Trello card gets completed but the Notion project page still shows it as in progress. A Notion database entry is created but no Trello card exists to track the actual work.

GAIA connects Trello and Notion so task management and documentation stay aligned. Trello card updates flow into Notion database entries, Notion project pages pull live Trello board status, and new Notion items trigger Trello card creation. Teams get the visual workflow benefits of Trello with the rich documentation capabilities of Notion, connected rather than siloed.

This integration is ideal for teams that use Notion as their company wiki while managing day-to-day tasks in Trello, and for project managers who need project documentation and task status to live in the same place.

useCases.title: Sync Trello cards to a Notion database
useCases.description: When a card is added to a Trello board, GAIA creates a corresponding entry in a Notion database with the card title, description, due date, and list status, keeping documentation in sync with execution.

useCases.title: Update Notion entries when Trello cards move
useCases.description: When a Trello card moves between lists — from Backlog to In Progress to Done — GAIA updates the status field on the linked Notion database entry, keeping the Notion project database accurate.

useCases.title: Create Trello cards from Notion database entries
useCases.description: When a new task is added to a Notion project database, GAIA creates the corresponding Trello card in the right list, ensuring every documented task has an actionable card for execution.

useCases.title: Embed Trello board summaries in Notion project pages
useCases.description: GAIA generates a structured Trello board status summary and appends it to the linked Notion project page on a scheduled basis, giving readers an accurate view of task progress without leaving Notion.

useCases.title: Archive completed cards to Notion
useCases.description: When a Trello card is completed and archived, GAIA appends a completion record to the Notion project page, building a running log of completed work that serves as project history and documentation.

howItWorks.step: Connect Trello and Notion to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Trello boards and your Notion workspace. Map specific Trello boards to Notion databases and define which fields correspond between the two platforms.

howItWorks.step: Set sync direction and trigger events
howItWorks.description: Choose whether to sync from Trello to Notion, Notion to Trello, or both. Configure which card events — creation, list movement, due date change, completion — trigger Notion updates.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps boards and databases aligned
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both platforms and propagates changes automatically so your Trello boards and Notion databases always reflect the same task state without manual data entry.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync Trello card labels to Notion tags?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA maps Trello card labels to Notion multi-select or tag fields. When a label is added or removed from a Trello card, GAIA updates the corresponding Notion entry field to match.

faqs.question: What happens to Notion entries when Trello cards are deleted?
faqs.answer: By default, GAIA marks the Notion entry as archived rather than deleting it, preserving project history. You can configure GAIA to delete entries instead if your workflow requires a clean database.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create a Trello board from a Notion project template?
faqs.answer: Yes. When a new project page is created in Notion from a template, GAIA can read the task list from the template and create a fully structured Trello board with lists and initial cards automatically.

trello-slack.tagline: Post Trello card updates to Slack and create cards directly from Slack messages
trello-slack.metaTitle: Trello + Slack Automation - Real-Time Board Updates in Slack
trello-slack.metaDescription: Connect Trello and Slack with GAIA. Get notified in Slack when Trello cards move, create new cards from Slack messages, and keep your team aligned without switching between tools.
trello-slack.intro:
Trello boards track work visually but only for people who are actively watching them. Team members in Slack miss card movements, due date changes, and completion events unless they check Trello directly. Conversely, important tasks discussed and agreed upon in Slack never make it into Trello because someone always has to manually create the card.

GAIA connects Trello and Slack so neither side has to change their habits. Trello events surface automatically in the right Slack channels, and tasks identified in Slack are captured in Trello without requiring anyone to leave the conversation. Teams that live in Slack stay informed about project progress, and tasks discussed in chat become trackable cards automatically.

This integration is particularly valuable for agile teams running sprints in Trello, customer support teams routing issues through Slack, and remote teams who use Slack as their digital office and Trello as their project board.

useCases.title: Post card completion updates to Slack channels
useCases.description: When a Trello card moves to the Done list, GAIA posts a formatted update to the designated Slack channel, celebrating progress and keeping the team informed without anyone checking the board manually.

useCases.title: Create Trello cards from Slack messages
useCases.description: When a task is identified in a Slack message, mention GAIA or react with a specific emoji and GAIA will create a Trello card from the message content, assign it to the right person, and confirm creation in the thread.

useCases.title: Daily board digest in Slack
useCases.description: GAIA posts a morning digest to a Slack channel listing all Trello cards due today, cards moved yesterday, and any overdue items, giving the team a quick project health snapshot without opening Trello.

useCases.title: Overdue card alerts
useCases.description: When a Trello card passes its due date without being completed, GAIA sends a Slack DM to the card's assigned member and a summary alert to the project channel so nothing slips through unnoticed.

useCases.title: New card assignment notifications
useCases.description: When a Trello card is assigned to a team member, GAIA sends them a Slack DM with the card title, description, due date, and board link, ensuring immediate awareness of new responsibilities.

howItWorks.step: Connect Trello and Slack to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Trello boards and your Slack workspace. Map Trello boards to Slack channels so updates from each board route to the appropriate team channel.

howItWorks.step: Configure which events post to Slack
howItWorks.description: Choose the Trello events that trigger Slack messages — card creation, movement between lists, due date arrival, completion, or assignment — and set the target channel for each event type.

howItWorks.step: GAIA bridges boards and chat in real time
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Trello for board activity and posts structured notifications to Slack as events occur, while also listening in Slack for card creation requests so tasks move from conversation to execution instantly.

faqs.question: Can GAIA post different Trello boards to different Slack channels?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure per-board Slack channel mappings so that updates from your marketing board go to the marketing channel, engineering board updates go to the engineering channel, and so on.

faqs.question: What format do Slack notifications from Trello take?
faqs.answer: GAIA posts structured Slack messages with the card title, current list, assignee, due date, and a direct link to the Trello card. Digest messages include a formatted table of cards grouped by status.

faqs.question: Can I create a Trello card from a Slack message without a bot command?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA supports emoji-based card creation — react to any Slack message with a designated emoji and GAIA will create a Trello card from that message automatically.

trello-github.tagline: Move Trello cards when PRs merge and link GitHub issues to Trello cards
trello-github.metaTitle: Trello + GitHub Automation - Connect Code Delivery to Project Boards
trello-github.metaDescription: Link your GitHub development workflow to Trello with GAIA. Automatically move Trello cards when pull requests merge, create cards from GitHub issues, and keep engineering and project management perfectly aligned.
trello-github.intro:
Software teams using Trello for project management and GitHub for code often face a visibility gap — Trello cards sit in In Progress long after the code has merged, and GitHub issues get filed without corresponding Trello cards for the product team to track. The disconnect means project status in Trello rarely reflects the actual state of development in GitHub.

GAIA connects Trello and GitHub so code events automatically update project boards and project cards trigger appropriate GitHub actions. When a pull request is merged, GAIA moves the linked Trello card to Done. When a GitHub issue is opened, GAIA can create the corresponding Trello card. The result is a Trello board that stays accurate without requiring engineers to manually update cards after every commit.

This integration is essential for small-to-medium development teams that use Trello for product planning and GitHub for all code activity, and for teams that need non-technical stakeholders to have accurate project visibility without access to GitHub.

useCases.title: Move Trello cards when pull requests merge
useCases.description: When a GitHub pull request linked to a Trello card is merged, GAIA automatically moves the card to the Done list, keeping the Trello board accurate without requiring manual updates from engineers.

useCases.title: Create Trello cards from GitHub issues
useCases.description: When a GitHub issue is opened with a specific label, GAIA creates a corresponding Trello card in the appropriate list, ensuring all engineering work items have a visible counterpart on the project board.

useCases.title: Reflect PR review status on Trello cards
useCases.description: When a pull request is submitted for review, GAIA moves the linked Trello card to a Review list and adds a comment with the PR link and reviewer list, giving the team visibility into the review stage.

useCases.title: Bug report cards from GitHub issue labels
useCases.description: When a GitHub issue is labeled as a bug, GAIA creates a Trello card in the bug triage list with the issue title, severity label, and GitHub link so the product team can prioritize the fix alongside other work.

useCases.title: Sprint velocity reporting
useCases.description: GAIA aggregates GitHub PR merge data and corresponding Trello card completions to generate sprint velocity reports, showing how many cards were completed and how long they spent in each list.

howItWorks.step: Connect Trello and GitHub to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Trello boards and your GitHub repositories. Configure which repositories trigger updates on which Trello boards.

howItWorks.step: Link Trello cards to GitHub issues or PRs
howItWorks.description: Reference Trello card IDs in GitHub PR descriptions or issue bodies, or use GAIA's automatic linking to match items by title and labels. GAIA maintains the link going forward.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps boards and code in sync
howItWorks.description: As GitHub events fire — issues opened, PRs submitted, PRs merged, issues closed — GAIA propagates the corresponding Trello card movements and updates automatically.

faqs.question: Do developers need to reference Trello card IDs in every PR?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. GAIA supports fuzzy matching between GitHub issues and Trello cards by title and label. Explicit card ID references give the most reliable links, but GAIA can infer matches for common workflows.

faqs.question: Can GAIA handle multiple GitHub repositories mapped to a single Trello board?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can map multiple repositories to a single Trello board, with per-repository label filters to control which issues and PRs create or update Trello cards.

faqs.question: What happens when a GitHub issue is closed without merging a PR?
faqs.answer: GAIA moves the linked Trello card to a Closed or Won't Do list based on your configuration, and adds a comment noting the issue was closed without a merge so the project team has the full context.

trello-google-calendar.tagline: Add Trello due dates to your calendar and create cards from calendar events
trello-google-calendar.metaTitle: Trello + Google Calendar Automation - Sync Task Deadlines with Your Calendar
trello-google-calendar.metaDescription: Connect Trello and Google Calendar with GAIA. Automatically add Trello card due dates to your calendar, create Trello cards from calendar events, and never miss a project deadline again.
trello-google-calendar.intro:
Trello due dates live inside boards that require active checking, while deadlines and commitments are most useful when they appear in your calendar alongside everything else on your plate. Without a connection between the two, team members miss Trello deadlines because they were not checking their board, or they schedule meetings without knowing that a Trello card deadline falls on the same day.

GAIA connects Trello and Google Calendar so due dates appear where people actually plan their time. Trello card due dates become calendar events with direct links back to the card. Calendar events for project reviews or client deliveries become Trello cards automatically. The result is a unified schedule that reflects both meetings and tasks without requiring manual entry in two places.

This integration is ideal for project managers who live in their calendar and freelancers who use Trello for client work but schedule everything through Google Calendar.

useCases.title: Add Trello due dates to Google Calendar
useCases.description: When a due date is set on a Trello card, GAIA creates a Google Calendar event at the due date and time, including the card title and a link back to the Trello card so the deadline is visible in your daily schedule.

useCases.title: Create Trello cards from calendar events
useCases.description: When a Google Calendar event is created with a specific keyword or in a designated project calendar, GAIA creates a Trello card with the event name, date, and description so the commitment is tracked in your project board.

useCases.title: Multi-stage deadline reminders
useCases.description: GAIA creates multi-stage Google Calendar reminders for Trello cards — a one-week warning, a two-day alert, and a same-day notification — so teams have sufficient lead time to complete work before deadlines.

useCases.title: Sprint calendar from Trello board
useCases.description: GAIA reads all due dates from a Trello sprint board and generates a Google Calendar sprint view, giving the team a time-based perspective on the sprint workload alongside their meeting schedule.

useCases.title: Reschedule overdue items automatically
useCases.description: When a Google Calendar event linked to a Trello card passes without the card being completed, GAIA moves the card to an Overdue list and reschedules the calendar event so the deadline gets a new target date.

howItWorks.step: Connect Trello and Google Calendar to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Trello boards and your Google Calendar. Select which boards and lists to monitor for due dates and which calendars to write events to.
Define how Trello card metadata maps to calendar event fields — title format, calendar selection, reminder timing, and what happens when a Trello due date changes.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps deadlines visible across both tools
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Trello for due date changes and Google Calendar for new events, synchronizing both systems so your schedule always reflects your actual project commitments.

faqs.question: What happens to the calendar event when a Trello due date is changed?
faqs.answer: GAIA automatically updates the linked Google Calendar event to match the new due date, so your calendar always reflects the current Trello deadline without manual edits.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create calendar events for an entire Trello board at once?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can ask GAIA to bulk-create calendar events for all cards with due dates on a specific Trello board, populating your calendar with the full project schedule in one operation.

faqs.question: Does GAIA sync Trello due times as well as dates?
faqs.answer: Yes. When a due time is set in Trello, GAIA creates a timed calendar event. When only a date is set, GAIA creates an all-day event for that date.

trello-drive.tagline: Attach Drive files to Trello cards and organize project assets automatically
trello-drive.metaTitle: Trello + Google Drive Automation - Link Documents to Your Trello Cards
trello-drive.metaDescription: Connect Trello and Google Drive with GAIA. Automatically create Drive folders for Trello boards, attach relevant files to cards, and keep all project documents organized and accessible from your Kanban board.
trello-drive.intro:
Trello cards represent work, but the actual work product — briefs, drafts, designs, reports — lives in Google Drive. Without a connection between the two, team members spend time searching Drive for files mentioned in Trello cards, or they attach outdated file links to cards when the document has since been updated or moved.

GAIA connects Trello and Google Drive so documents are organized around cards automatically. When a new Trello board is created, GAIA sets up the corresponding Drive folder structure. As cards progress through lists, GAIA attaches relevant files and notifies team members when documents are updated. The result is a Trello board where every card has immediate access to all related documents without manual file hunting.

This integration is especially useful for marketing teams managing campaigns in Trello, content teams tracking article production, and project managers who need all deliverables organized and accessible from a single card view.

useCases.title: Create Drive folders for new Trello boards
useCases.description: When a new Trello board is created, GAIA automatically creates a corresponding Google Drive folder with subfolders matching the board's lists, providing an organized document structure from day one.

useCases.title: Auto-attach Drive files to Trello cards
useCases.description: When a file is added to a Drive folder linked to a Trello board, GAIA attaches the file to the appropriate Trello card based on naming conventions or list-to-folder mappings, keeping files accessible directly from the card.

useCases.title: Notify card members when files are updated
useCases.description: When a Drive file attached to a Trello card is modified, GAIA posts a comment on the card notifying the assigned member, ensuring the latest version is reviewed rather than an outdated cached copy.

useCases.title: Deliverable submission workflow
useCases.description: When a team member adds a completed deliverable to a Drive folder, GAIA moves the linked Trello card to the Review list and attaches the file, triggering the review stage without any manual card updates.

useCases.title: Archive project files when cards complete
useCases.description: When a Trello card is moved to Done, GAIA moves associated Drive files to a completed deliverables subfolder, keeping the active project folder clean while preserving all final assets.

howItWorks.step: Authorize Trello and Google Drive in GAIA
howItWorks.description: Connect your Trello account and Google Drive to GAIA. Specify the Drive root folder where board folders should be created and the Trello boards to monitor.

howItWorks.step: Configure folder structure and attachment rules
howItWorks.description: Define the Drive folder template for new boards and the rules GAIA uses to match Drive files to Trello cards — by file name pattern, subfolder, or card label.

howItWorks.step: GAIA organizes documents around your cards
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both Trello and Drive for changes, attaching files to cards, creating folders for new boards, and notifying team members when documents are updated.

faqs.question: Can GAIA attach a Drive file to a specific Trello card on request?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ask GAIA to find a specific Drive file by name and attach it to a Trello card by title or card ID. GAIA searches Drive, retrieves the file link, and adds it to the card.

faqs.question: What happens to Drive files when a Trello card is deleted?
faqs.answer: GAIA does not delete Drive files when a Trello card is removed. It can optionally move the files to an archive folder and log the card deletion so documents are preserved for reference.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create a Drive document from a Trello card template?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to create a Drive document from a specified template when a Trello card is created in a specific list, pre-filling the document with card metadata such as title, assignee, and due date.

파일 상태가 바뀌면 GAIA가 카드를 옮기고, 업데이트된 파일 링크를 붙이며, 관련 팀원에게 알려 디자인 리뷰 과정이 자동으로 순조롭게 돕니다.

trello-figma.intro:
Trello에서 업무를 관리하는 제품팀과 Figma에서 일하는 디자인팀이 반복되는 인계 문제에 부딪힙니다. 디자이너가 Slack·이메일로 링크를 공유하지만 그 링크가 카드에 오르지 않습니다. 제품 매니저가 디자인이 준비됐는지 보려고 보드를 보지만 첨부 파일도 상태 업데이트도 없습니다. 그 결과 개발을 늦추고 어떤 디자인 버전이 최신인지 혼란스럽게 하는 파편화된 리뷰 과정이 따릅니다.

GAIA가 둘을 연결해 디자인 산출물이 항상 올바른 카드에 첨부되고 디자인 상태 변경이 자동으로 카드를 워크플로우에 올립니다. 프로젝트용으로 파일이 업데이트되면 GAIA가 연결된 카드에 첨부합니다. Figma에서 디자인이 승인되면 GAIA가 카드를 다음 단계로 옮깁니다. 팀이 선호 도구에만 있고 인계는 자동으로 일어납니다.

수동 상태 업데이트를 없애고 프로젝트 보드에서 디자인 자산이 항상 보이게 하려는 제품·디자인팀용으로 만들었습니다.

trello-discord.tagline: Post Trello board updates to Discord community channels automatically
trello-discord.metaTitle: Trello + Discord Automation - Board Updates in Your Discord Server
trello-discord.metaDescription: Keep your Discord community informed with GAIA. Automatically post Trello card completions, new assignments, and board activity to Discord channels so your team always knows what's happening.
trello-discord.intro:
Communities and teams that organize in Discord need project updates to surface in the platform where they already spend their time. When Trello board activity — card completions, new assignments, milestone achievements — stays locked inside Trello, Discord-first teams are left in the dark unless they actively check the board.

GAIA connects Trello and Discord so board activity flows automatically into the right Discord channels. Card completions get posted to team channels, new cards notify assignees in DMs, and board summaries keep the broader community informed of project progress. Teams working on open-source projects, game development, or community initiatives can share project updates with their Discord audience without any manual copy-pasting.

This integration is particularly suited for open-source communities, gaming studios, creator collectives, and any team that runs its community on Discord while tracking project work in Trello.

useCases.title: Post card completions to Discord channels
useCases.description: When a Trello card moves to Done, GAIA posts a formatted message to the designated Discord channel with the card title, board, and assignee, keeping the community informed of progress milestones.

useCases.title: Notify assignees via Discord DM
useCases.description: When a Trello card is assigned to a team member, GAIA sends them a Discord direct message with the card details, due date, and board link so they are immediately aware of the new task.

useCases.title: Weekly board digest in Discord
useCases.description: GAIA posts a weekly Trello board summary to a Discord channel listing completed cards, in-progress items, and upcoming due dates, giving the community a regular project health update.

useCases.title: Sprint completion announcements
useCases.description: When all cards in a Trello sprint list are completed, GAIA posts a sprint completion announcement to the Discord server with a summary of what was accomplished, building team morale and community visibility.

useCases.title: Create Trello cards from Discord messages
useCases.description: Mention GAIA in a Discord message to create a Trello card directly from the conversation, ensuring that ideas and tasks raised in Discord channels are captured in the project board without context switching.

howItWorks.step: Connect Trello and Discord to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Trello boards and your Discord server. Configure which Trello boards map to which Discord channels for update notifications.
Choose which Trello events trigger Discord messages — card creation, movement, completion, assignment, or overdue — and customize the message format to match your community's style.
GAIA monitors Trello board activity and posts formatted notifications to Discord automatically, so your community and team are always informed without manual effort.

faqs.question: Can GAIA post updates from multiple Trello boards to different Discord channels?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure per-board channel mappings so that different project boards post to their respective Discord channels, keeping notifications organized and relevant to each audience.

faqs.question: Can community members create Trello cards from Discord without board access?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can accept Trello card creation requests from Discord users who do not have direct Trello access, acting as the bridge between the community and the project board.

faqs.question: Will every Trello card movement create a Discord notification?
faqs.answer: Only the event types you configure will generate Discord messages. Most teams post only completions and major milestones to keep channels readable rather than notifying on every card move.

trello-zoom.tagline: Schedule Trello sprint calls and post Zoom meeting summaries back to cards
trello-zoom.metaTitle: Trello Zoom 연동: 스프린트 회의와 요약
trello-zoom.metaDescription: Trello 보드에서 스프린트 회의를 시작하세요. GAIA가 카드 단계 변경 시 Zoom을 예약하고 요약을 카드에 올립니다. 설정 단계를 확인하세요.
trello-zoom.intro:
Trello sprint boards drive the rhythm of project work, but much of that work is coordinated in Zoom meetings — sprint planning calls, card review sessions, retrospectives. Without automation, teams manually schedule meetings that should be triggered by board events, and the action items discussed on those calls never find their way back into Trello cards without someone taking detailed notes and manually creating cards afterward.

GAIA connects Trello and Zoom so meetings are scheduled automatically at the right board stage and meeting outcomes flow back into the board immediately after each call. When a Trello sprint list is fully populated and ready to start, GAIA schedules the sprint kickoff call. When the call ends, GAIA posts the meeting summary to the board and creates Trello cards from action items extracted from the transcript.

This integration is built for agile teams, project managers, and any group that runs structured board reviews on Zoom and needs meeting outcomes to live inside Trello where the actual work is tracked.

useCases.title: Schedule sprint kickoff calls from board stage changes
useCases.description: When a Trello board moves to a new sprint stage or a sprint list is populated, GAIA schedules a Zoom kickoff call with the team, sends calendar invites, and attaches the meeting link to the Trello board.

useCases.title: Post Zoom meeting summaries to Trello cards
useCases.description: After a Zoom call associated with a Trello board, GAIA generates a meeting summary from the transcript and posts it as a comment on the relevant card, creating a permanent discussion record.

useCases.title: Create Trello cards from Zoom action items
useCases.description: GAIA analyzes Zoom call transcripts for action items and creates corresponding Trello cards in the appropriate list, with the action item as the card title and the responsible person as the assignee.

useCases.title: Sprint retrospective scheduling
useCases.description: When all cards in a Trello sprint list are completed, GAIA schedules a retrospective Zoom call with the team and attaches a retrospective summary template to the Trello board for preparation.

useCases.title: Card review sessions for blocked items
useCases.description: When multiple Trello cards are flagged as blocked, GAIA schedules a Zoom unblocking session with the relevant card owners and posts a pre-meeting agenda to the board with all blocked cards listed.

howItWorks.step: Connect Trello and Zoom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Trello boards and Zoom account. Link your calendar so GAIA can schedule meetings that fit the team's availability.

howItWorks.step: Configure board events that trigger meetings
howItWorks.description: Define which Trello board states or list events should trigger Zoom meetings, who should be invited, and when the meeting should be scheduled relative to the board event.

howItWorks.step: GAIA schedules calls and captures outcomes
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Trello for trigger events, schedules Zoom meetings, and after each call posts summaries and action item cards back to the board automatically.

faqs.question: Can GAIA schedule a Zoom call directly from a Trello card comment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mention GAIA in a Trello card comment asking for a meeting, and GAIA will schedule a Zoom call with the card members, check calendar availability, and post the meeting link back to the card.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require Zoom cloud recording for meeting summaries?
faqs.answer: Zoom transcription or cloud recording must be enabled on the meeting for GAIA to generate summaries. GAIA accesses the transcript after the meeting ends and generates a structured summary.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create recurring sprint meetings based on Trello sprint cycles?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can schedule recurring Zoom sprint calls based on your Trello board's sprint cadence, automatically adding the meeting link to the board and updating the invite as team membership changes.

hubspot-notion.tagline: Sync HubSpot CRM data to Notion docs and document deals and customer research
hubspot-notion.metaTitle: HubSpot Notion 연동: 딜과 연락처를 Notion에
hubspot-notion.metaDescription: HubSpot 딜로 Notion 페이지를 만들고, 연락처를 데이터베이스에 동기화하며, 단계 변경도 GAIA가 자동 기록합니다. 설정 단계를 확인하세요.
hubspot-notion.intro:
HubSpot Notion 연동은 CRM 레코드를 Notion으로 복사해 거래 메모, 계정 조사, 파이프라인 보고서를 팀의 다른 문서와 같은 곳에 두게 해 줍니다. GAIA를 두 앱에 연결하면 규칙을 한 번만 설명하면 됩니다. HubSpot의 새 연락처를 Notion 데이터베이스에 추가하기, 새 거래마다 Notion 페이지 만들기, 거래 단계 변경을 Notion에 기록하기 같은 것입니다. GAIA는 정한 일정(매시간, 매일 아침, 매주)에 따라 HubSpot을 확인하고 새로 생기거나 바뀐 레코드를 Notion에 기록합니다.

방향에 따라 동작이 다릅니다. GAIA에는 HubSpot 이벤트 트리거가 없으므로, HubSpot에서 Notion으로는 거래가 생기는 순간이 아니라 일정에 따라 실행되며, 실행 사이에는 Notion이 한 주기만큼 늦을 수 있습니다. Notion에서 HubSpot으로는 이벤트 방식이 가능합니다. 회의록 같은 Notion 데이터베이스에 페이지가 추가되면 GAIA가 해당 HubSpot 연락처나 거래에 메모로 기록합니다.

HubSpot의 모든 속성을 몇 분 안에 Notion에 반영해야 한다면 Zapier나 Make 같은 전용 자동화 도구가 더 적합합니다. GAIA는 과정에 판단이 필요한 팀에 맞습니다. 연락처의 최근 이메일까지 담은 조사 페이지, 문장으로 정리한 주간 파이프라인 요약, 모든 것을 복사하지 않고 테스트 거래와 중복 거래를 걸러 내는 일 등입니다.

useCases.title: HubSpot의 새 거래마다 Notion 페이지 만들기
useCases.description: 예약 실행 때마다 GAIA가 지난 실행 이후 생성된 거래를 찾아 Notion 거래 데이터베이스에 페이지를 만듭니다. 거래 이름, 금액, 단계, 마감 예정일, 연결된 연락처와 함께 설명해 둔 조사 템플릿도 넣습니다.

useCases.title: HubSpot의 새 연락처를 Notion 데이터베이스에 추가
useCases.description: GAIA가 새 연락처를 이름, 이메일, 회사, 직함, 라이프사이클 단계와 함께 Notion 데이터베이스로 복사합니다. 팀은 HubSpot을 열지 않고 Notion에서 계정을 찾아볼 수 있습니다.

useCases.title: HubSpot 거래 단계 변경을 Notion에 기록
useCases.description: 실행할 때마다 GAIA가 진행 중인 거래의 단계를 Notion 항목과 비교합니다. 단계가 바뀌었다면 Stage 속성을 업데이트하고 거래 페이지에 날짜가 붙은 줄을 추가해, Notion에 단계 이력이 쌓입니다.

useCases.title: Notion에 주간 파이프라인 요약 작성
useCases.description: 매주 정한 일정에 GAIA가 진행 중인 거래를 읽고, 단계별 거래, 총액, 이번 달 마감 예정 거래, 마감 예정일이 지난 거래를 정리한 Notion 페이지를 작성합니다.

useCases.title: Notion 회의록을 HubSpot에 기록
useCases.description: Notion 회의록 데이터베이스에 페이지가 추가되면 GAIA가 HubSpot에서 해당 연락처나 거래를 찾아 메모를 기록합니다. CRM 타임라인이 빠짐없이 유지됩니다.

howItWorks.description: GAIA의 연동 페이지에서 둘 다 추가합니다. Notion에서는 GAIA가 기록할 데이터베이스(예: Deals, Contacts, Accounts)를 공유해 주세요.

워크플로를 만들고 원하는 동작을 적습니다. 예를 들어 "매시간 HubSpot의 새 거래마다 Deals 데이터베이스에 페이지를 만들고 금액, 단계, 마감 예정일, 주 연락처를 넣어 줘"나 "매일 아침 각 Notion 거래 페이지의 Stage 속성을 HubSpot에 맞춰 업데이트해 줘"처럼요. 어떤 HubSpot 속성을 어떤 Notion 속성에 넣을지도 적어 주세요.
HubSpot에서 Notion으로 가는 워크플로는 정한 일정에 따라 실행되고, Notion에서 HubSpot으로 가는 워크플로는 Notion 페이지가 생성될 때 실행됩니다. 실행할 때마다 짧은 보고를 받을 수 있고, 언제든 바로 실행해 달라고 요청할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: Notion 회의록을 HubSpot으로 다시 동기화할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네. Notion 회의록 데이터베이스에 페이지가 추가되면 GAIA가 해당 HubSpot 거래나 연락처에 메모로 기록해 CRM 타임라인을 빠짐없이 유지합니다.

faqs.question: Notion 페이지는 거래별로 만드나요, 계정별로 만드나요?
faqs.answer: 둘 다 가능합니다. 기회를 자세히 추적하는 거래별 페이지든, 한 회사의 모든 거래와 연락처를 모으는 회사별 페이지든 원하는 구조를 설명해 주세요.

faqs.question: HubSpot 사용자 지정 속성을 Notion 사용자 지정 필드로 동기화할 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네. GAIA는 HubSpot 사용자 지정 속성을 읽고 쓸 수 있습니다. 워크플로 설명에 어떤 HubSpot 속성을 어떤 Notion 속성에 넣을지 적어 주세요. 바뀐 값은 다음 예약 실행 때 기록됩니다.

faqs.question: HubSpot에서 거래가 생기는 순간 Notion도 업데이트되나요?
faqs.answer: 아니요. GAIA에는 HubSpot 이벤트 트리거가 없어서 정한 일정에 따라 HubSpot을 확인합니다. 매시간 실행하는 워크플로라면 10시 10분에 생긴 거래는 11시 실행 때 Notion에 나타납니다. 지금 바로 동기화해 달라고 요청할 수도 있습니다.

faqs.question: Notion의 데이터를 HubSpot으로 보낼 수 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네. Notion 트리거로 페이지가 생성되거나 속성이 바뀔 때 워크플로를 시작할 수 있습니다. 그러면 GAIA가 그 페이지를 바탕으로 HubSpot 연락처, 회사, 거래를 만들거나 업데이트하고, 기존 레코드에 메모로 기록할 수도 있습니다.

faqs.question: Zapier나 Make의 HubSpot Notion 자동화와 무엇이 다른가요?
faqs.answer: Zapier나 Make 자동화는 하나의 트리거에서 정해진 필드를 복사하며, 필드만 옮기면 되는 경우에는 더 간단한 선택입니다. GAIA는 평소 말로 쓴 설명을 바탕으로 동작하므로 읽고 판단해야 하는 일도 처리합니다. 거래 페이지에 연락처의 최근 이메일 요약을 더하고, 테스트 거래를 건너뛰고, 주간 파이프라인 요약을 문장으로 쓰는 일 등입니다.

hubspot-asana.tagline: Create onboarding and delivery tasks in Asana from new HubSpot deals
hubspot-asana.metaTitle: HubSpot + Asana 연동: 성사된 거래를 프로젝트 업무로
hubspot-asana.metaDescription: GAIA로 HubSpot + Asana 연동. HubSpot 거래가 성사되면 Asana 온보딩 프로젝트를 만들고 거래 데이터를 업무에 동기화합니다. 영업과 실행팀이 같은 정보를 봅니다.
hubspot-asana.intro:
Every closed deal in HubSpot represents a handoff that needs to happen — from sales to customer success, implementation, or delivery. Without automation, that handoff relies on a salesperson remembering to notify the right team, and the delivery team manually creating Asana tasks that should have been generated from the deal data already sitting in HubSpot.

GAIA automates the sales-to-delivery handoff so nothing falls through the cracks. When a HubSpot deal closes, GAIA creates a structured Asana project or task list for the relevant delivery team, pre-populated with customer details from the CRM. As the onboarding progresses, GAIA can log Asana milestone completions back to HubSpot so account managers stay informed without interrupting the delivery team.

This integration is built for SaaS companies, professional services firms, and agencies where closing a deal immediately generates structured delivery work that needs to be tracked in Asana.

useCases.title: Auto-create onboarding projects from closed deals
useCases.description: When a HubSpot deal reaches Closed Won, GAIA creates a new Asana project from the appropriate onboarding template, pre-fills customer details, assigns the customer success team, and sets deadlines based on contract start date.

useCases.title: Sync deal data to Asana project fields
useCases.description: GAIA maps HubSpot deal fields — company name, contract value, product purchased, primary contact — to Asana project custom fields so the delivery team has full context without accessing HubSpot.

useCases.title: Log Asana milestone completions in HubSpot
useCases.description: When key Asana onboarding tasks are completed, GAIA logs the milestones as HubSpot deal activities, keeping account managers informed of onboarding progress directly in their CRM view.

useCases.title: Escalate at-risk onboardings to HubSpot
useCases.description: When an Asana onboarding project is overdue or flagged as at-risk, GAIA creates a HubSpot task for the account owner to reach out to the client proactively, preventing churn before it happens.

useCases.title: Trigger HubSpot sequences from Asana completions
useCases.description: When an Asana onboarding project is marked complete, GAIA enrolls the client in a HubSpot post-onboarding email sequence, initiating the customer success phase without any manual CRM action.

howItWorks.step: Connect HubSpot and Asana to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your HubSpot portal and Asana workspace. Map HubSpot pipeline stages and deal properties to Asana project templates and task fields.
Configure which HubSpot deal stages or properties trigger Asana project creation, which Asana template to use for each deal type, and which fields to pre-populate from CRM data.

howItWorks.step: GAIA bridges sales and delivery automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors HubSpot for deal stage changes and creates Asana projects immediately, while also reporting Asana milestone progress back to HubSpot so both teams work from accurate, shared data.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create different Asana templates for different HubSpot deal types?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to select Asana project templates based on HubSpot deal properties such as product line, contract tier, or customer segment, ensuring the right task structure for each engagement.

faqs.question: What happens in Asana if a HubSpot deal is reopened after being closed?
faqs.answer: GAIA can detect deal stage reversals and notify the Asana project team, or optionally pause or archive the Asana project, depending on how your workflow handles deal reversals.

faqs.question: Can sales reps see Asana onboarding progress without an Asana account?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA logs Asana milestone completions as HubSpot activities so account managers see onboarding progress inside HubSpot without needing Asana access.

hubspot-linear.tagline: Link customer feature requests in HubSpot to engineering issues in Linear
hubspot-linear.metaTitle: HubSpot + Linear 연동: 고객 피드백을 개발팀으로
hubspot-linear.metaDescription: GAIA로 HubSpot + Linear 연동. HubSpot 거래의 기능 요청에서 Linear 이슈를 만들고 CRM에서 요청 상태를 추적합니다. 고객 피드백이 제품 반영까지 이어집니다.
hubspot-linear.intro:
Sales teams capture customer feature requests in HubSpot notes and deal fields, but those requests rarely make it to the engineering team in a structured way. Engineers using Linear have no visibility into which customer asked for a feature or how many deals depend on it. Product decisions get made without the revenue context sitting in HubSpot, and customers wait for features without any feedback loop.

GAIA connects HubSpot and Linear so customer requests drive engineering priorities with full context attached. When a sales rep logs a feature request in HubSpot, GAIA creates or links a Linear issue with the customer details, deal value, and request frequency. When the engineering team ships the feature, GAIA notifies the account owner in HubSpot so they can update the customer before the customer asks.

This integration is essential for product-led and sales-assisted SaaS companies that want feature development to be informed by real customer demand rather than internal guesswork.

useCases.title: Create Linear issues from HubSpot feature requests
useCases.description: When a sales rep logs a feature request on a HubSpot deal or contact, GAIA creates a corresponding Linear issue with the request details, customer name, deal value, and request frequency so engineering has full context.

useCases.title: Track request popularity across deals
useCases.description: GAIA aggregates HubSpot feature request notes across multiple deals and updates a Linear issue's description with a running count of requesting customers and combined deal value, helping engineering prioritize by revenue impact.

useCases.title: Notify account owners when features ship
useCases.description: When a Linear issue linked to a HubSpot feature request is marked Done, GAIA creates a HubSpot task for the account owner to reach out to requesting customers, closing the feedback loop before customers follow up.

useCases.title: Link Linear issues to HubSpot deal records
useCases.description: GAIA adds Linear issue links to HubSpot deal records so account managers can check engineering status on customer-requested features directly from the CRM without needing Linear access.

useCases.title: Escalate high-value feature blockers
useCases.description: When a HubSpot deal is blocked by a missing feature, GAIA escalates the linked Linear issue with a priority flag and deal value annotation, ensuring engineering leadership sees the revenue at stake.

howItWorks.step: Connect HubSpot and Linear to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your HubSpot portal and Linear organization. Configure which HubSpot properties indicate a feature request and which Linear team should receive the issues.

howItWorks.step: Define request capture and linking rules
howItWorks.description: Set the HubSpot deal or contact properties that GAIA monitors for feature requests, and configure how GAIA deduplicates requests — creating a new Linear issue or linking to an existing one.

howItWorks.step: GAIA closes the loop between customers and engineering
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors HubSpot for new requests and Linear for issue completions, creating issues, updating request counts, and notifying account owners when requested features are shipped.

faqs.question: Can GAIA deduplicate feature requests from multiple HubSpot deals?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA matches requests by feature name or description and links multiple HubSpot records to a single Linear issue, updating the issue with a count of requesting customers rather than creating duplicates.

faqs.question: Can account managers see Linear issue status from HubSpot?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA adds the Linear issue link and current status to the HubSpot deal or contact record, so account managers can see whether a feature is backlogged, in progress, or shipped without accessing Linear.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support HubSpot custom properties for feature request tracking?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to read feature request data from any HubSpot custom property on deal or contact records, not just standard fields, so it fits your existing CRM data model.

hubspot-google-calendar.tagline: Sync meeting invites with HubSpot contacts and log calls automatically
hubspot-google-calendar.metaTitle: HubSpot + Google Calendar Automation - Sync Sales Meetings with CRM
hubspot-google-calendar.metaDescription: Connect HubSpot and Google Calendar with GAIA. Automatically log calendar meetings as HubSpot activities, create follow-up tasks from call outcomes, and keep your CRM timeline accurate without manual entry.
hubspot-google-calendar.intro:
Sales reps spend significant time in Google Calendar scheduling and attending client meetings, but those meetings rarely make it into HubSpot automatically. CRM activity timelines go stale, meeting notes get lost in calendar event descriptions instead of living on the contact record, and follow-up tasks get created late or not at all because the rep moved on to the next call.

GAIA connects HubSpot and Google Calendar so every client meeting automatically appears in the CRM timeline without manual logging. When a Google Calendar meeting includes a HubSpot contact, GAIA creates the corresponding HubSpot meeting activity, attaches any pre-meeting notes, and after the meeting creates follow-up tasks based on the meeting outcome.

This integration is built for account executives, SDRs, and customer success managers who live in Google Calendar for scheduling but need their CRM to reflect every client touchpoint accurately.

useCases.title: Log calendar meetings as HubSpot activities automatically
useCases.description: When a Google Calendar event includes a HubSpot contact's email address, GAIA automatically creates a corresponding meeting activity on the HubSpot contact or deal record, keeping the CRM timeline accurate without manual logging.

useCases.title: Create follow-up tasks from meeting outcomes
useCases.description: After a meeting ends, GAIA creates a HubSpot follow-up task on the associated deal with a configurable due date, prompting the rep to send notes or take the next agreed action before moving on.

useCases.title: Attach meeting notes to HubSpot records
useCases.description: When a rep adds notes to a Google Calendar event before or after a meeting, GAIA copies those notes to the HubSpot contact or deal record as an activity note, ensuring meeting context lives in the CRM.

useCases.title: Schedule HubSpot follow-up meetings from CRM tasks
useCases.description: When a HubSpot task requires a follow-up call, GAIA checks the rep's Google Calendar availability and creates a calendar event with the contact's details, saving the rep the context-switching of scheduling manually.

useCases.title: Pipeline stage updates from meeting cadence
useCases.description: GAIA monitors meeting frequency between reps and HubSpot contacts and alerts the rep when a deal's meeting cadence drops below a threshold, prompting proactive outreach before a deal goes cold.

howItWorks.step: Connect HubSpot and Google Calendar to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your HubSpot portal and Google Calendar. GAIA matches calendar attendee email addresses to HubSpot contact records automatically.

howItWorks.step: Configure logging rules and follow-up templates
howItWorks.description: Define which calendar events should be logged to HubSpot — by calendar, attendee domain, or event keyword — and set the follow-up task template that GAIA creates after each meeting.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps your CRM timeline complete
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Google Calendar for client meetings and logs them to HubSpot automatically, creating follow-up tasks and syncing notes so your CRM reflects every touchpoint without manual effort.

faqs.question: Does GAIA log internal meetings or only external client meetings?
faqs.answer: You can configure GAIA to log only meetings with external email domains matched to HubSpot contacts, excluding internal team meetings from CRM logging to keep activity timelines relevant.

faqs.question: What happens when a meeting is rescheduled or cancelled?
faqs.answer: GAIA updates the linked HubSpot activity record when a Google Calendar event is rescheduled, and marks it as cancelled if the event is deleted, keeping the CRM timeline accurate.

faqs.question: Can GAIA log meetings for multiple reps across a sales team?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA supports team-level configurations so that calendar meetings for all reps in the sales team are automatically logged to their respective HubSpot contact and deal records.

hubspot-drive.tagline: Attach Drive proposals and contracts to HubSpot deals automatically
hubspot-drive.metaTitle: HubSpot + Google Drive 연동: 영업 문서 자동 저장
hubspot-drive.metaDescription: GAIA로 HubSpot + Google Drive 연동. HubSpot의 제안서, 계약서, 영업 자료를 Drive 폴더에 자동 저장합니다. 모든 영업 문서가 깔끔하게 정리됩니다.
hubspot-drive.intro:
Sales deals generate significant documentation — proposals, contracts, SOWs, case studies, presentations — that typically lives in Google Drive while the deal itself lives in HubSpot. Without a connection, reps waste time searching Drive for the right version of a proposal, or they share the wrong file because the Drive folder structure does not map to HubSpot deal records.

GAIA connects HubSpot and Google Drive so the right documents are always attached to the right deal. When a new deal is created, GAIA creates a structured Drive folder for the account. As deal documents are created or updated in Drive, GAIA attaches them to the HubSpot deal record. When a contract is signed and moved to a signed folder, GAIA updates the HubSpot deal and creates the next-stage task automatically.

This integration is essential for sales teams that generate custom proposals, account executives managing complex deal cycles with multiple documents, and revenue operations teams that need document management to be automatic and auditable.

useCases.title: Create Drive folders for new HubSpot deals
useCases.description: When a new deal is created in HubSpot, GAIA creates a structured Google Drive folder for the account with subfolders for proposals, contracts, and supporting materials, and attaches the folder link to the deal record.

useCases.title: Auto-attach proposals to HubSpot deals
useCases.description: When a proposal document is created in a deal's Drive folder, GAIA automatically attaches the file to the linked HubSpot deal record so the document is accessible from the CRM without manual attachment.

useCases.title: Notify reps when contracts are ready for review
useCases.description: When a contract document is added to a deal's Drive folder, GAIA creates a HubSpot task for the rep to review and send it, ensuring contracts move through the approval process without sitting unnoticed in Drive.

useCases.title: Log document activity on deal timeline
useCases.description: When a proposal or contract in Drive is opened by the recipient, GAIA logs a document engagement activity on the HubSpot deal timeline so the rep knows when the prospect is reviewing materials.

useCases.title: Advance deal stage when contracts are signed
useCases.description: When a signed contract is added to a deal's Drive folder, GAIA advances the HubSpot deal to Closed Won, records the signed date, and creates the post-sale handoff task, closing the sales cycle automatically.

howItWorks.step: Connect HubSpot and Google Drive to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your HubSpot portal and Google Drive. Specify the root Drive folder where account deal folders should be created and the HubSpot pipelines to monitor.

howItWorks.step: Configure folder templates and attachment rules
howItWorks.description: Define the Drive folder structure for new deals and the rules GAIA uses to attach files to HubSpot records — by file name, subfolder, or document type.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps deal documents organized and linked
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both HubSpot and Drive for changes, creating folders, attaching documents, and logging activity so your CRM always reflects the current state of your deal documentation.

faqs.question: Can GAIA generate proposals from HubSpot deal data and save them to Drive?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can use a Drive document template and populate it with HubSpot deal fields — company name, contact, product, pricing — to generate a proposal draft, saving it to the deal's Drive folder automatically.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support multiple document types per deal?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can manage multiple document types — proposals, NDAs, contracts, SOWs — each attached to the appropriate HubSpot deal section and organized in the correct Drive subfolder.

faqs.question: Can GAIA detect when a shared Drive document has been viewed by the prospect?
faqs.answer: GAIA can log when a shared Drive link is accessed if Google Drive sharing analytics are available. For detailed document engagement tracking, integrating a dedicated proposal tool provides richer data.

hubspot-zoom.tagline: Log Zoom calls to HubSpot and create follow-up tasks from call notes
hubspot-zoom.metaTitle: HubSpot + Zoom 연동: 영업 통화 기록과 후속 업무 생성
hubspot-zoom.metaDescription: GAIA로 HubSpot + Zoom 연동. Zoom 통화를 HubSpot 연락처와 거래에 자동 기록하고 녹취록에서 액션 아이템을 추출합니다. 영업 대화가 CRM에 최신으로 남습니다.
hubspot-zoom.intro:
Sales reps conduct dozens of Zoom calls every week, but those calls rarely make it into HubSpot automatically. Activity timelines go stale, call notes sit in personal documents rather than the CRM, and follow-up commitments made on the call are forgotten because the rep moved straight to the next meeting without logging the outcome.

GAIA connects HubSpot and Zoom so every sales call is captured in the CRM automatically. When a Zoom meeting includes a HubSpot contact, GAIA logs the call as a CRM activity and generates a summary from the transcript. Committed action items become HubSpot tasks, and key conversation points are attached to the deal record so anyone on the account team can get up to speed without listening to the recording.

This integration is built for sales teams that want complete CRM activity timelines, managers who need call visibility without listening to recordings, and account teams who need to hand off deals with full conversation context.

useCases.title: Log Zoom calls as HubSpot activities automatically
useCases.description: When a Zoom meeting includes a HubSpot contact's email address, GAIA logs the call as a meeting activity on the contact and deal record, including the call duration, attendees, and a link to the recording.

useCases.title: Post call summaries to HubSpot deal records
useCases.description: After a Zoom call, GAIA generates a structured summary from the meeting transcript and posts it to the linked HubSpot deal record as a note, giving the entire account team immediate access to call outcomes.

useCases.title: Create follow-up tasks from action items
useCases.description: GAIA analyzes Zoom call transcripts for commitments and action items — send a proposal, schedule a demo, loop in a technical contact — and creates corresponding HubSpot tasks with due dates for the responsible rep.

useCases.title: Advance deal stage from call outcomes
useCases.description: When a Zoom call summary indicates a specific outcome — verbal agreement, request for contract, demo completed — GAIA can advance the HubSpot deal to the next pipeline stage automatically.

useCases.title: Manager call coaching alerts
useCases.description: GAIA monitors Zoom call summaries for coaching signals — long monologues, no next steps agreed, competitor mentions — and creates a HubSpot task for the sales manager to review the recording and provide feedback.

howItWorks.step: Connect HubSpot and Zoom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your HubSpot portal and Zoom account. GAIA matches Zoom meeting attendees to HubSpot contact records by email address.

howItWorks.step: Configure logging rules and follow-up templates
howItWorks.description: Define which Zoom meetings should be logged to HubSpot — by attendee domain, meeting type, or calendar invitation — and set the task templates GAIA creates from call action items.

howItWorks.step: GAIA logs every call and drives follow-through
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Zoom for completed meetings, logs them to HubSpot, generates summaries, and creates follow-up tasks automatically so your CRM reflects every sales conversation and every commitment made.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require Zoom cloud recording for call logging?
faqs.answer: Basic call logging — duration, attendees, date — works without recording. Generating call summaries and extracting action items requires Zoom transcription or cloud recording to be enabled on the meeting.

faqs.question: Can GAIA match Zoom calls to the correct HubSpot deal when a contact has multiple open deals?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA uses the deal currently in an active stage for the contact by default, and you can configure it to prompt the rep to confirm the deal association when ambiguity exists.

faqs.question: Can managers access Zoom call summaries for their reps from HubSpot?
faqs.answer: Yes. Call summaries are logged as HubSpot note activities on the deal or contact record, so anyone with CRM access — including managers and account team members — can read the summary without accessing Zoom.

salesforce-slack.tagline: Post deal alerts to Slack and update Salesforce records from Slack messages
salesforce-slack.metaTitle: Salesforce + Slack 연동: 실시간 거래 알림
salesforce-slack.metaDescription: GAIA로 Salesforce + Slack 연동. 거래 단계 변경을 Slack으로 즉시 알리고 Slack 메시지에서 CRM 레코드를 갱신합니다. 영업팀이 주 사용 도구에서 바로 소통합니다.
salesforce-slack.intro:
Revenue teams live in Slack but their deal data lives in Salesforce, and the gap between the two means critical deal events go unnoticed until someone checks the CRM. A deal closes and the broader team finds out hours later. A deal goes cold and no one escalates because the signal was buried in a Salesforce report nobody opened.

GAIA connects Salesforce and Slack so deal intelligence flows into the conversations where decisions are made. Won deals trigger immediate Slack announcements to the revenue channel. At-risk opportunities generate alerts to the account owner. High-value pipeline updates surface in leadership channels. And when a rep needs to update Salesforce quickly, they can do it from Slack without switching tabs.

This integration is essential for high-velocity sales teams where deal momentum depends on real-time information, and for revenue leaders who need pipeline visibility without pulling reports manually.

useCases.title: Celebrate closed deals in Slack instantly
useCases.description: When a Salesforce opportunity is marked Closed Won, GAIA posts a deal win announcement to the revenue Slack channel with the deal name, value, account, and rep, giving the team immediate visibility and morale.

useCases.title: Alert account owners about at-risk deals
useCases.description: When a Salesforce deal's close date passes without progressing or is moved back multiple times, GAIA sends a Slack DM to the account owner and a channel alert to the sales manager to trigger intervention.

useCases.title: Update Salesforce fields from Slack
useCases.description: Reps can message GAIA in Slack to update Salesforce deal fields — close date, stage, next step, amount — without opening Salesforce, reducing CRM friction for field reps and fast-moving deal cycles.

useCases.title: Weekly pipeline digest in Slack
useCases.description: GAIA posts a structured weekly pipeline digest to the revenue Slack channel listing deals by stage, total pipeline value, deals closing this week, and deals that have not been updated in over a week.

useCases.title: New lead alerts for high-priority accounts
useCases.description: When a new Salesforce lead is created for a target account or high-value company, GAIA posts an immediate alert to the designated Slack channel so the right rep can respond before the lead goes cold.

howItWorks.step: Connect Salesforce and Slack to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Salesforce organization and Slack workspace. Map Salesforce pipeline stages and record types to Slack channels for notifications.

howItWorks.step: Configure alert rules and channel mappings
howItWorks.description: Define which Salesforce events — stage changes, deal wins, overdue dates, new leads — trigger Slack messages, and specify the target channel or user for each alert type.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps your revenue team informed in real time
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Salesforce for deal events and posts structured notifications to Slack immediately, while also accepting CRM update requests from Slack to keep deal data current.

faqs.question: Can GAIA post Salesforce alerts to different Slack channels for different deal sizes?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to route alerts based on deal value — enterprise deals to a dedicated channel, SMB deals to another — so the right audience sees each notification.

faqs.question: What Salesforce fields can be updated from Slack?
faqs.answer: GAIA supports updating standard Salesforce fields — stage, close date, amount, next step, description — and custom fields via natural language commands in Slack. The update is reflected in Salesforce immediately.

faqs.question: Can GAIA notify the full account team, not just the deal owner?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can notify all Slack users mapped to the Salesforce account team for a given deal, ensuring everyone with a stake in the account is informed of significant events.

salesforce-gmail.tagline: Log emails to Salesforce automatically and create leads from Gmail replies
salesforce-gmail.metaTitle: Salesforce + Gmail Automation - Log Every Email to CRM Automatically
salesforce-gmail.metaDescription: Connect Salesforce and Gmail with GAIA. Automatically log client emails to Salesforce deal and contact records, create leads from inbound email replies, and keep your CRM activity timeline complete without manual entry.
salesforce-gmail.intro:
Sales reps send and receive dozens of client emails every day in Gmail, but those emails rarely make it into Salesforce without a deliberate BCC to the CRM email address or a manual activity log. The result is a Salesforce record that understates contact frequency, misses key conversation threads, and fails to capture the email trail that might be critical for deal reviews or handoffs.

GAIA connects Salesforce and Gmail so every relevant client email is logged to the correct CRM record automatically. When a Gmail message is sent to or received from a Salesforce contact, GAIA logs the email as an activity on the contact and opportunity record. When a promising email reply arrives from an unknown address, GAIA can create a new lead in Salesforce so the prospect enters the pipeline immediately.

This integration is built for sales teams that want complete CRM activity timelines without requiring reps to remember to log emails, and for revenue operations teams who need accurate engagement data for pipeline analysis and forecasting.

useCases.title: Log Gmail emails to Salesforce contact records automatically
useCases.description: When a Gmail email is sent to or received from a Salesforce contact's email address, GAIA logs the email as an activity on the contact record with the subject, timestamp, and direction, keeping the CRM timeline complete.

useCases.title: Create Salesforce leads from inbound email replies
useCases.description: When an inbound Gmail reply arrives from an email address not in Salesforce, GAIA creates a new lead with the sender's name, email, company, and the email content as the lead description, triggering immediate follow-up.

useCases.title: Attach emails to Salesforce opportunity records
useCases.description: GAIA matches Gmail emails to the relevant Salesforce opportunity based on the contact association and logs the email on both the contact and the deal record, giving account teams full deal email history in the CRM.

useCases.title: Identify unresponsive prospects from email gaps
useCases.description: GAIA monitors Gmail activity for Salesforce contacts and alerts the rep when a prospect has not replied to an email in a configurable number of days, prompting follow-up before the deal goes cold.

useCases.title: Draft Salesforce-informed email responses
useCases.description: When a client email arrives, ask GAIA to draft a reply using CRM context — deal stage, last meeting notes, open tasks — so the response is personalized and accurate without the rep switching to Salesforce to look up details.

howItWorks.step: Connect Salesforce and Gmail to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Salesforce organization and Gmail account. GAIA matches Gmail sender and recipient addresses to Salesforce contact and lead records automatically.

howItWorks.step: Configure logging rules and lead creation criteria
howItWorks.description: Define which Gmail emails to log — by contact domain, label, or thread — and set the criteria for when an unknown email address should create a new Salesforce lead versus be ignored.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps every client email in your CRM
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Gmail for inbound and outbound messages matching Salesforce contacts and logs them automatically, while also creating leads from high-potential inbound emails so no prospect slips through.

faqs.question: Does GAIA log every email or only emails to Salesforce contacts?
faqs.answer: By default, GAIA logs only emails where the sender or recipient matches a Salesforce contact or lead email address. You can also configure it to log emails from specific domains or Gmail labels.

faqs.question: Can GAIA attach the full email body to Salesforce or just a summary?
faqs.answer: GAIA logs the email subject, timestamp, direction, and a configurable amount of the body text to the Salesforce activity record. Full email bodies can be included if your Salesforce storage limits allow.

faqs.question: What happens when an email involves multiple Salesforce contacts?
faqs.answer: GAIA logs the email to all matching Salesforce contact records in the thread and associates it with the relevant open opportunity for each contact, ensuring no touchpoint is missed on multi-stakeholder deals.

salesforce-notion.tagline: Sync Salesforce deal data to Notion and document account strategies collaboratively
salesforce-notion.metaTitle: Salesforce + Notion Automation - Bring CRM Data into Your Notion Workspace
salesforce-notion.metaDescription: Connect Salesforce and Notion with GAIA. Automatically create Notion deal pages from Salesforce opportunities, sync pipeline data to Notion databases, and keep account strategies aligned with live CRM data.
salesforce-notion.intro:
Enterprise sales teams manage complex deals that require rich documentation — account strategies, stakeholder maps, competitive positioning, executive briefings — that cannot live inside Salesforce's structured fields. Notion is where this content gets written, but it stays disconnected from the live deal data in Salesforce. Account documents go stale, pipeline dashboards in Notion require manual updates, and new team members cannot find the strategic context built up during the deal cycle.

GAIA connects Salesforce and Notion so deal intelligence flows between CRM and knowledge base automatically. When a Salesforce opportunity is created, GAIA creates a Notion deal page from an account strategy template pre-populated with CRM data. As the deal progresses, GAIA updates the Notion page with stage changes and key metrics. When account strategies or meeting notes are added to Notion, GAIA can log key outcomes back to Salesforce.

This integration is designed for enterprise sales teams, strategic account managers, and revenue operations teams that manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals requiring both structured CRM tracking and rich collaborative documentation.

useCases.title: Create Notion deal pages from Salesforce opportunities
useCases.description: When a Salesforce opportunity is created or reaches a qualifying stage, GAIA creates a Notion deal page from an account strategy template, pre-filled with opportunity name, value, stage, contacts, and close date.

useCases.title: Sync pipeline stages and key metrics to Notion databases
useCases.description: GAIA maintains a Notion database of Salesforce opportunities, keeping stage, value, close date, and rep fields synchronized so pipeline dashboards in Notion always reflect live CRM data.

useCases.title: Document stakeholder maps in Notion with Salesforce contact data
useCases.description: GAIA pulls Salesforce contact records associated with an opportunity and populates the stakeholder map section of the Notion deal page, giving the account team a collaborative space to build relationship strategies.

useCases.title: Log Notion meeting notes to Salesforce activities
useCases.description: When a meeting notes section is updated on a Notion deal page, GAIA creates a corresponding activity note on the Salesforce opportunity, keeping the CRM timeline complete without requiring reps to log in two places.

useCases.title: Executive briefing generation
useCases.description: Before a high-value deal review, GAIA compiles a Notion executive briefing page pulling Salesforce deal data, activity history, and risk signals alongside the strategic notes from the Notion deal page.

howItWorks.step: Connect Salesforce and Notion to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Salesforce organization and Notion workspace. Map Salesforce opportunity fields to Notion database properties and deal page sections.

howItWorks.step: Configure page templates and sync triggers
howItWorks.description: Define the Notion deal page template, choose which Salesforce pipeline stages trigger page creation or updates, and set which Notion changes should log back to Salesforce as activities.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps strategy and CRM aligned
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Salesforce for deal changes and Notion for document updates, propagating data in both directions so your strategic documentation always reflects live deal reality.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create different Notion templates for different Salesforce deal types?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to select Notion page templates based on Salesforce opportunity type, record type, or product line, ensuring the right strategic framework is applied to each deal.

faqs.question: How often does GAIA sync Salesforce data to the Notion pipeline database?
faqs.answer: GAIA syncs on configurable intervals — real-time on stage changes, or on a scheduled basis for field updates. You can also trigger a manual sync on demand for a specific opportunity.

faqs.question: Can multiple team members collaborate on a Notion deal page while GAIA syncs CRM data?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA writes to specific structured sections of the Notion deal page — CRM-synced fields, activity logs — while leaving collaborative sections free for the account team to edit without conflict.

salesforce-asana.tagline: Create Asana projects from Salesforce opportunities and sync delivery back to CRM
salesforce-asana.metaTitle: Salesforce + Asana Automation - From Closed Deal to Delivery Project
salesforce-asana.metaDescription: Bridge sales and delivery with GAIA. Automatically create Asana projects when Salesforce deals close, sync project milestones back to CRM records, and keep account managers and delivery teams working from shared data.
salesforce-asana.intro:
Closing a deal in Salesforce is only the beginning — the delivery team then needs to execute on the commitments made during the sale. Without automation, the handoff from Salesforce to Asana is manual: someone copies deal details into a new project, assigns tasks by hand, and sets deadlines without referencing the contract dates in Salesforce. The delivery team starts every engagement with incomplete information.

GAIA automates the Salesforce-to-Asana handoff so delivery begins the moment a deal closes. When a Salesforce opportunity reaches Closed Won, GAIA creates a structured Asana project pre-populated with all relevant deal data — company name, scope, contract dates, assigned delivery lead — and assigns tasks based on your delivery playbook. As the project progresses, GAIA reports milestones back to Salesforce so the account team always knows where delivery stands.

This integration is critical for professional services teams, SaaS implementation teams, and any organization where closing a deal immediately creates structured project work that must be tracked in Asana.

useCases.title: Auto-create Asana projects from Salesforce Closed Won deals
useCases.description: When a Salesforce opportunity is marked Closed Won, GAIA immediately creates an Asana project from the appropriate delivery template, pre-fills account details, sets contract-aligned deadlines, and assigns the delivery team.

useCases.title: Sync Salesforce contract data to Asana project fields
useCases.description: GAIA maps Salesforce deal fields — product, contract value, implementation timeline, primary contact — to Asana custom project fields so the delivery team has the sales context they need without CRM access.

useCases.title: Report Asana delivery milestones to Salesforce
useCases.description: When key Asana project milestones are completed, GAIA logs them as Salesforce activity records on the linked account and opportunity, giving account managers delivery status visibility in their CRM.

useCases.title: Alert account managers about at-risk deliveries
useCases.description: When an Asana project is flagged at-risk or falls behind schedule, GAIA creates a Salesforce task for the account owner to proactively communicate with the client and manage expectations.

useCases.title: Generate renewal opportunities from project completion
useCases.description: When an Asana project is marked complete, GAIA creates a new Salesforce opportunity for renewal or expansion, pre-populated with the account details and a renewal timeline based on the original contract.

howItWorks.step: Connect Salesforce and Asana to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Salesforce organization and Asana workspace. Map Salesforce opportunity fields to Asana project templates and define the delivery team assignment rules.
Define which Salesforce pipeline stages trigger Asana project creation, which Asana template to use per deal type, and which Asana milestone completions report back to Salesforce.

GAIA monitors Salesforce for deal closures and creates Asana projects instantly, while also reporting delivery progress back to Salesforce so account managers stay informed without interrupting the delivery team.

faqs.question: Can GAIA select different Asana templates based on Salesforce deal attributes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Configure GAIA to select Asana templates based on Salesforce fields such as product line, contract size, or customer segment, so the right delivery structure is applied to each type of engagement.

faqs.question: What happens if a Salesforce deal is reopened after the Asana project has started?
faqs.answer: GAIA can detect deal stage reversals and notify the Asana project manager. The Asana project is not automatically deleted — a human decision is needed to pause, cancel, or continue delivery work.

faqs.question: Can account managers in Salesforce see Asana project task-level details?
faqs.answer: GAIA logs milestone-level updates to Salesforce rather than individual task details, keeping the CRM record high-level. Account managers can request a project summary from GAIA at any time for more detail.

salesforce-google-calendar.tagline: Sync sales calls and meetings with Salesforce CRM activities automatically
salesforce-google-calendar.metaTitle: Salesforce + Google Calendar Automation - Log Sales Meetings to CRM
salesforce-google-calendar.metaDescription: Connect Salesforce and Google Calendar with GAIA. Automatically log client meetings as CRM activities, create follow-up tasks from calendar events, and keep your Salesforce activity timeline complete without manual entry.
salesforce-google-calendar.intro:
Account executives and sales reps schedule and attend client meetings in Google Calendar every day, but those meetings only help the team if they are captured in Salesforce. Manual CRM logging is time-consuming and inconsistently done — reps log some meetings, forget others, and rarely capture enough detail for the next person who inherits the account to understand the relationship history.

GAIA connects Salesforce and Google Calendar so every client meeting is automatically recorded in the CRM with zero manual effort from the rep. When a Google Calendar event involves a Salesforce contact, GAIA creates the activity record, attaches meeting notes, and after the meeting generates follow-up tasks based on what was agreed. The Salesforce timeline becomes a complete, accurate record of all client touchpoints without relying on rep discipline.

This integration is essential for enterprise sales teams managing complex deal cycles, customer success managers with large books of business, and revenue operations teams that need accurate activity data for pipeline analysis and forecasting.

useCases.title: Log Google Calendar meetings as Salesforce activities
useCases.description: When a Google Calendar event includes a Salesforce contact's email address, GAIA automatically creates a meeting activity on the Salesforce contact and opportunity record with attendees, date, and duration.

useCases.title: Create Salesforce follow-up tasks after meetings
useCases.description: When a calendar meeting with a Salesforce contact ends, GAIA creates a follow-up task on the opportunity with a configurable due date, prompting the rep to send notes or take the next agreed action.

useCases.title: Attach pre-meeting research to Salesforce records
useCases.description: Before a scheduled meeting with a Salesforce contact, GAIA compiles a meeting brief from CRM data — deal stage, last activities, open tasks — and attaches it to the calendar event so the rep arrives prepared.

useCases.title: Identify deal engagement gaps
useCases.description: GAIA monitors Salesforce opportunities for contacts who have not had a calendar meeting scheduled in a configurable number of days and alerts the rep, ensuring high-value deals maintain appropriate meeting cadence.

useCases.title: Schedule Salesforce-informed follow-up meetings
useCases.description: When a Salesforce task requires a follow-up meeting, GAIA checks the rep's Google Calendar availability and the contact's suggested times to create a meeting invite automatically, reducing scheduling back-and-forth.

howItWorks.step: Connect Salesforce and Google Calendar to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Salesforce organization and Google Calendar accounts. GAIA matches calendar attendee email addresses to Salesforce contact and lead records automatically.

howItWorks.step: Configure logging rules and follow-up automation
howItWorks.description: Define which calendar events trigger Salesforce activity creation — by attendee domain, calendar, or event type — and set the follow-up task template that GAIA creates after each meeting.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps your CRM timeline complete
